title: Q&A with Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on claims that its digital twins predict human behavior with 85%+ accuracy, its goal of simulating all 8B people, and more (Mario Gabriele/The Generalist)
title_en: Q&A with Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on claims that its digital twins predict human behavior with 85%+ accuracy, its goal of simulating all 8B people, and more (Mario Gabriele/The Generalist)
author: The Generalist
article_content:
“In any truly advanced civilization that gets depicted [in science fiction], you really see two pillars of scientific progress. One is some form of AGI, and the other a simulation. And I was always more drawn to the idea of simulation.” – Joon Sung Park, Co-Founder and CEO of Simile

Before Joon Sung Park and I had ever met, he simulated the conversation. What questions would Mario, or a person like Mario, ask him? What would I find most interesting to dig into? I do not know how closely I adhered to my facsimile, though I wish I did.

Joon has an advantage in rehearsing these encounters, and thousands of others. He is the Co-founder and CEO of Simile, an applied AI company building a foundation model of human behavior. That involves creating digital twins of real people – like a writer or podcaster – and simulating how they might react to certain circumstances. As you might imagine, that’s an attractive proposition for many companies: CVS Health, for instance, can test a new pricing policy against thousands of simulated patients. A bank can model how customers will react before announcing a fee change. Joon’s ambitions stretch far beyond these cases, though, and Simile has raised more than $300 million, most recently at a $2 billion valuation, to pursue them.

The portrait artist always paints themselves. I loved this line from Joon, who happens to be a gifted painter in his own right. When apprehending a piece of art – whatever the medium – I can sometimes forget to consider what it tells us about the author rather than the subject.

“Emotional rigor.” Another phrase of Joon’s that I’ve been sitting with. This was how he described the intensity one needs to build to paint a beautiful painting of someone. You need to build this deep, rigorous connection. This is a universal lesson, I think, and especially true in writing.

Contradictory superpowers. Another really sharp heuristic (can you tell I enjoyed this conversation quite a lot?). When it comes to hiring, this...

title_zh: Simile欲用AI数字孪生模拟人类行为
summary_zh: Simile公司CEO朴俊圣在访谈中阐述了其开发人类行为基础模型、构建数字孪生以预测人类反应的宏大愿景
article_content_zh:
“在[科幻小说中]描绘的任何真正先进的文明中，你确实看到了科学进步的两大支柱。一个是某种形式的通用人工智能，另一个是模拟。而我总是对模拟的想法更感兴趣。” – Joon Sung Park，Simile 联合创始人兼首席执行官

在我和朴俊成见面之前，他就模拟了对话。马里奥或像马里奥这样的人会问他什么问题？我觉得最值得深入研究的是什么？我不知道我对传真的坚持有多严格，尽管我希望如此。

琼在排练这些遭遇以及其他数千场遭遇方面具有优势。他是 Simile 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，Simile 是一家应用人工智能公司，致力于构建人类行为的基础模型。这涉及创建真人（如作家或播客）的数字双胞胎，并模拟他们对某些情况的反应。正如您可能想象的那样，这对许多公司来说是一个有吸引力的提议：例如，CVS Health 可以针对数千名模拟患者测试新的定价政策。银行可以在宣布费用调整之前模拟客户的反应。不过，Joon 的野心远远超出了这些案件，Simile 已筹集了超过 3 亿美元的资金来追求这些目标，最近的估值为 20 亿美元。

肖像画家总是画自己。我喜欢 Joon 的这句话，他本身就是一位有天赋的画家。当理解一件艺术作品时——无论何种媒介——我有时会忘记考虑它告诉我们关于作者而不是主题的信息。

“情感上的严谨。”我一直在听 Joon 的另一句话。他这样描述了为某人画一幅美丽的画所需要的强度。你需要建立这种深刻、严格的联系。我认为这是一个普遍的教训，在写作中尤其如此。

矛盾的超能力。另一个非常尖锐的启发式（你能看出我非常喜欢这次谈话吗？）。在招聘时，Joon 寻找的就是这样的人：具有两种很少同时具备的优势的人。例如，一位有着深厚的科学严肃性和非常顽皮的一面的同事。

向后工作。 Joon 的最终目标不是给 Simile 一个问题并让它做出预测。它是给出一个像气候变化这样的“邪恶”问题，并让它模拟大量可能的路径，以帮助我们找到最好的路径。

当一切都可以预测时谁会获胜？如果模拟像 Simile 所暗示的那样无处不在，那么公司如何相互竞争呢？ “战略”作为一门广泛的学科，是否已得到解决？ Joon 指出了关于边缘可能仍然存在的一些想法——即观点、专有数据和计算。当然，这只是一个思想实验。但这三者中的两家可能会为世界上资源最丰富的公司带来回报，但这远非理想。

当我问 Joon 他会给每个人分配哪本书时，他给大家起名叫《麦田里的守望者》，他第一次读这本书是在 14 或 15 岁左右。他小心翼翼地说，最重要的书都是非常个人化的，但霍尔顿·考尔菲尔德对年轻人内心的描绘却让他印象深刻。在我们谈话的早些时候，他还指出阿西莫夫的基础系列是《Simile》的核心灵感，特别是心理史学的想法：给模拟器一个理想的最终状态，并向后寻找那里的路径。

乔恩·罗森出版了一本新书《城堡》。我只读了几页，但考虑到我喜欢他所有其他奇异、随心所欲的调查，我怀疑我会非常喜欢它。

Grok Bot 在这一点上确实非常出色。我怀疑这种形式因素——由协调者监督的持久、主动、特定任务的机器人——将成为专业工作的默认形式。这是最接近拥有一群数字同事的事情。

title: Pharmaceutical leaders are skeptical of claims that AI could cure most diseases within a decade; the US FDA has yet to clear any AI-designed biotech drugs (Xavier Martinez/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: Pharmaceutical leaders are skeptical of claims that AI could cure most diseases within a decade; the US FDA has yet to clear any AI-designed biotech drugs (Xavier Martinez/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet: No drug designed by artificial intelligence has won FDA clearance, and pharma leaders say biology is the obstacle
summary_en: Global pharmaceutical leaders have expressed skepticism toward claims that AI could cure most diseases within a decade, highlighting that the US FDA has yet to clear any AI-designed biotech drugs. This caution stems from the massive gap between Silicon Valley's grand tech narratives and the brutal realities of clinical trials and regulatory hurdles.
title_zh: 医药巨头集体唱衰AI十年内包治百病
summary_zh: 全球制药行业领袖对AI能在十年内治愈多数疾病的狂热言论表示质疑，并指出美国FDA至今未批准任何一款完全由AI设计的生物医药

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 全球制药行业领袖在近期行业交流与公开场合中，对硅谷流传的“AI将在十年内治愈绝大多数人类疾病”的乐观预测泼了冷水，其核心背景在于科技圈的宏大叙事与严苛的医药现实之间存在巨大鸿沟。这群掌握真金白银研发预算的医药大佬指出，尽管AI概念被炒得火热，但截至目前，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）甚至没有批准过哪怕一款完全由AI独立设计出来的生物医药。这场质疑折射出算法极客的 PPT 故事，在面临九死一生且长达十年的临床试验与监管红线时，正在遭遇传统医药工业的强力现实解构。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Global pharmaceutical leaders have expressed skepticism toward claims that AI could cure most diseases within a decade, highlighting that the US FDA has yet to clear any AI-designed biotech drugs. This caution stems from the massive gap between Silicon Valley's grand tech narratives and the brutal realities of clinical trials and regulatory hurdles.

ai_analysis.insight_en: Silicon Valley loves to disrupt industries with slide decks, but pharma leaders simply asked to see the FDA approval letters. Turns out clinical trials don't care about your latest transformer architecture.

title: Meta raised $15B in a US dollar bond sale; sources: the offering drew as much as $58B in orders and is the biggest portion of a $20B+ cross-border bond offering (Bloomberg)
title_en: Meta raised $15B in a US dollar bond sale; sources: the offering drew as much as $58B in orders and is the biggest portion of a $20B+ cross-border bond offering (Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Meta Platforms Inc. raised $15 billion from a US dollar bond sale, drawing solid demand as it became the latest Big Tech company …
summary_en: Meta successfully raised $15 billion through a US dollar bond sale, attracting a staggering $58 billion in investor orders as part of a larger $20 billion+ cross-border financing plan. Faced with an intensifying AI arms race, Meta is leveraging debt to secure the massive computational resources required for its long-term infrastructure and model development goals.
title_zh: Meta举债150亿美元扩充算力
summary_zh: Meta通过发行美元债券筹集150亿美元资金，市场认购需求高达580亿美元，将用于支持大规模AI基础设施建设
article_content_zh:
Meta此次发债是公司资本扩张战略的一部分，旨在通过低成本资金置换，确保在AI模型参数规模不断飙升的背景下，能够持续支付高昂的英伟达算力集群账单。

尽管全球宏观经济环境存在波动，但华尔街对于Meta在AI领域的落地能力表现出极高信心。580亿美元的超额认购不仅体现了投资者对Meta现金流的认可，也侧面印证了当前大厂通过财务杠杆加注AI基础设施已成为行业标准动作。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta近日通过发行美元债券成功募集150亿美元，此次发债吸引了高达580亿美元的强劲市场认购，是其总计逾200亿美元跨国融资计划的核心部分。面对日益白热化的AI大模型军备竞赛，Meta正通过大举举债来锁定昂贵的算力资源，以确保其在模型研发与基础设施建设上的持久战力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Meta successfully raised $15 billion through a US dollar bond sale, attracting a staggering $58 billion in investor orders as part of a larger $20 billion+ cross-border financing plan. Faced with an intensifying AI arms race, Meta is leveraging debt to secure the massive computational resources required for its long-term infrastructure and model development goals.

title: California accepts $1.42B in federal broadband funding, but challenges the Trump administration's demand that it stop enforcing state net neutrality rules (Jon Brodkin/Ars Technica)
title_en: California accepts $1.42B in federal broadband funding, but challenges the Trump administration's demand that it stop enforcing state net neutrality rules (Jon Brodkin/Ars Technica)
author: Ars Technica
article_content:
State tries to obtain broadband funds despite rejecting Trump admin condition.

California is accepting $1.42 billion in broadband grant funding from the Trump administration, but the state is not accepting the Trump administration’s demand that it stop enforcing a net neutrality law and other telecom regulations.

California’s stand against the Trump administration could result in multiple legal battles involving the state, federal government, and Internet providers seeking government funds. Although California told the federal government it would accept the money, it is reserving the right to challenge the condition imposed by the US. The state could delay or cancel plans to distribute broadband grants depending on how the process unfolds.

The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) decided last year that states must agree not to enforce any rate regulation or net neutrality rule on ISPs that receive money from the $42 billion Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program. California had to decide whether to accept its share of the fund despite that restriction. California is slated to spend $1.42 billion to deploy broadband to 270,571 locations, and may ultimately receive up to $1.86 billion from BEAD for a mix of deployment and non-deployment projects.

State officials argue that California should be able to obtain the money and keep enforcing its laws because the Trump administration’s demand would violate the state’s constitutional rights. The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) made its view clear in a carefully worded letter yesterday to Assistant Secretary of Commerce and NTIA Administrator Arielle Roth.

“The CPUC cannot be bound by any terms or conditions that are unconstitutional or not authorized by law and it expressly does not waive or concede any arguments or challenges concerning the legality, interpretation, or applicability of any term or condition,” CPUC President John Reynolds told Roth.

article_content_zh:
尽管拒绝特朗普的行政条件，该州仍试图获得宽带资金。

加州正在接受特朗普政府提供的 14.2 亿美元宽带拨款资金，但该州没有接受特朗普政府要求其停止执行网络中立法和其他电信法规的要求。

加州反对特朗普政府的立场可能会导致涉及州、联邦政府和寻求政府资金的互联网提供商的多起法律诉讼。尽管加州告诉联邦政府它将接受这笔钱，但它保留质疑美国施加的条件的权利。该州可能会推迟或取消分配宽带拨款的计划，具体取决于进程的进展情况。

美国国家电信和信息管理局 (NTIA) 去年决定，各州必须同意不对从 420 亿美元宽带公平、接入和部署 (BEAD) 计划中获得资金的 ISP 实施任何费率监管或网络中立规则。尽管存在这一限制，加州仍必须决定是否接受其在该基金中的份额。加州计划斥资 14.2 亿美元在 270,571 个地点部署宽带，最终可能从 BEAD 获得高达 18.6 亿美元的部署和非部署项目。

州官员认为，加州应该能够获得这笔资金并继续执行其法律，因为特朗普政府的要求将侵犯该州的宪法权利。加州公用事业委员会 (CPUC) 昨天在致助理商务部长兼 NTIA 局长 Arielle Roth 的一封措辞谨慎的信中明确表达了自己的观点。

“CPUC 不受任何违宪或未经法律授权的条款或条件的约束，并且明确不会放弃或承认任何有关任何条款或条件的合法性、解释或适用性的争论或质疑，”CPUC 主席约翰·雷诺兹 (John Reynolds) 告诉罗斯。

雷诺兹的信中还表示，CPUC 无法阻止加州其他机构执行州法律，这表明总检察长将保留惩罚行为不当的互联网提供商的权利。

雷诺兹在信中承认 NTIA 可能不同意 CPUC 的立场，并表示在州和联邦机构解决任何分歧之前，州不会向 ISP 分配任何资金。如果 NTIA 拒绝改变立场，加州可能会以该条件违宪为由起诉特朗普政府。

NTIA 似乎不太可能弯曲。 NTIA 发言人今天告诉 Ars：“正如该部门对 CPUC 的回应中所指出的，该裁决的条款和条件构成了 NTIA 与 CPUC 之间的完整协议。信中概述 CPUC 担忧的任何部分均未纳入该裁决或成为该裁决的一部分。”

消费者权益倡导组织 Public Knowledge 支持 CPUC 的立场。该组织表示，特朗普政府要求优先于各州法律的要求是“厚颜无耻且毫无根据的”。

Public Knowledge 高级政策顾问 Raza Panjwani 表示：“本届政府荒谬地要求行业全面豁免承受能力要求、网络中立性和隐私保护以及任何其他连接和服务美国人的承诺，这在建立 BEAD 的基础设施投资和就业法案 (IIJA) 中没有任何依据。而且，正如委员会指出的那样，NTIA 无权改变加州法律或要求加州机构不执行法律。”

CPUC 于 9 月投票批准了该资助计划。但雷诺兹在昨天给特朗普政府的信中表示，他的机构接受这笔资金是“基于 CPUC 对 BEAD 条款和条件第 50 条影响的最佳理解”。 BEAD 规则第 50 条规定，每个州：

应承诺，当子受让人拥有仍处于其履行期限、延长期限内的任何分赠款时，不会对子受让人或其在州内提供服务的任何地方（即 BEAD 和非 BEAD 地点）的附属机构执行任何直接或间接规范宽带互联网服务的费率、条款和条件的法律、法规、命令、合同要求或其他可执行义务……或对宽带互联网服务强加网络中立规则、开放接入或其他公用事业风格的规则。绩效或联邦利息期。

BEAD 规则规定，网络中立性规则是禁止 ISP“阻止内容、限制速度、施加数据上限或参与付费优先级”...

title: Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually (Isabel O'Brien/CNBC)
title_en: Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually (Isabel O'Brien/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Google is playing defense on Tuesday after a political backlash to its new policy surrounding use of artificial intelligence in schools.

In a blog post titled "Designing responsible AI for learning," Google said it's bringing AI into its Classroom offering with a product called Guided Learning. The New York Times published a story saying that the company will turn off search for schools that reject AI entirely.

Following the Times' story, prominent left-leaning politicians, including Sen. Bernie Sanders from Vermont and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani voiced their outrage on social media.

"Google is trying to use its monopoly power to force AI into our public schools," Mamdani wrote on X. Sanders wrote that "Google is threatening schools," referring to the policy as "extortion."

Google responded later in the day. In a post on X, the company said its new policy was meant to give schools more choice over how students interact with AI. Google said its Gemini chatbot, Gemini Notebook and search are turned off by default, and that "schools are in control," with the ability to turn them as they see fit.

"We are also updating Search for schools to make it better for learning," Google wrote. "Specifically, AI Mode and AI Overviews will offer step-by-step guided learning through problems, so that students don't get quick answers to schoolwork."

The company's post didn't explicitly respond to the claim that access to search requires use of AI. However, Chris Phillips, vice president for education at Google, told the Times that "Search and AI are deeply integrated."

A Google spokesperson referred CNBC to the X post when asked for comment.

Google's broader practices have come under fire in recent years, with the company losing antitrust cases over its search and advertising businesses. Former Federal Trade Commission Chair Lina Khan aggressively pursued Google and other tech giants, including Meta and Amazon.

article_content_zh:
谷歌周二在学校使用人工智能的新政策遭到政治强烈反对后，采取了防御措施。

谷歌在一篇题为“为学习设计负责任的人工智能”的博客文章中表示，它将通过一款名为“引导学习”的产品将人工智能引入其课堂产品。 《纽约时报》发表报道称，该公司将停止搜索完全拒绝人工智能的学校。

在《泰晤士报》报道后，包括佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯和纽约市长佐兰·马姆达尼在内的著名左倾政客在社交媒体上表达了他们的愤怒。

Mamdani 在 X 上写道：“谷歌正试图利用其垄断力量迫使人工智能进入我们的公立学校。”桑德斯写道，“谷歌正在威胁学校”，并将该政策称为“勒索”。

谷歌当天晚些时候做出了回应。该公司在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，其新政策旨在让学校在学生与人工智能互动的方式上有更多选择。谷歌表示，其 Gemini 聊天机器人、Gemini Notebook 和搜索默认情况下处于关闭状态，并且“学校处于控制之中”，可以根据需要关闭它们。

谷歌写道：“我们还在更新学校搜索，以使其更好地学习。” “具体来说，人工智能模式和人工智能概述将通过问题提供逐步指导学习，这样学生就不会快速获得作业的答案。”

该公司的帖子没有明确回应访问搜索需要使用人工智能的说法。然而，谷歌教育副总裁克里斯·菲利普斯(Chris Phillips)告诉《泰晤士报》，“搜索和人工智能是深度融合的。”

当被要求置评时，谷歌发言人向 CNBC 推荐了 X 帖子。

近年来，谷歌更广泛的做法受到了批评，该公司在搜索和广告业务方面输掉了反垄断诉讼。前联邦贸易委员会主席莉娜·汗 (Lina Khan) 积极追捧谷歌和其他科技巨头，包括 Meta 和亚马逊。

Khan 周二在 X 上发帖称，谷歌新的人工智能学习政策凸显了“允许不受监管的垄断者控制基本服务的危险”。

这是有关技术对儿童的影响以及领先的互联网公司在传递信息方面所扮演的角色的最新争议。

8 月，Meta 在儿童安全审判中达成了具有里程碑意义的 167 亿美元和解协议，此前一些州总检察长指控该公司歪曲了 Facebook 和 Instagram 等应用程序对儿童心理健康造成的伤害程度。

同月，在各州总检察长对该公司的安全实践发起调查后，OpenAI 推出了针对青少年的 ChatGPT，佛罗里达州总检察长、共和党人 James Uthmeier 于 6 月提起诉讼。

非营利组织 Common Sense Media 最近给予谷歌的人工智能概述“不可接受的风险”评级。上个月，康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (Richard Blumenthal) 和密苏里州共和党参议员乔什·霍利 (Josh Hawley) 对谷歌将人工智能推入课堂的行为发起了调查。

title: Cat Wu, product lead for Claude Code and Cowork, has left Anthropic; Thariq Shihipar, who worked on Claude Code, announced his departure last month (Stephen Council/Business Insider)
title_en: Cat Wu, product lead for Claude Code and Cowork, has left Anthropic; Thariq Shihipar, who worked on Claude Code, announced his departure last month (Stephen Council/Business Insider)
author: Business Insider
article_content:
Save Saved Listen to this story Wu did not say what prompted her departure and did not immediately respond to requests for comment. She's leaving at a crucial moment for Anthropic, as it churns toward a gargantuan initial public offering later this month. The company confirmed her departure. Thariq Shihipar, who also worked on Claude Code, announced his own departure last month.

Wu joined Anthropic in summer 2024 and tested an early prototype of Claude Code. In Tuesday's post, she reminisced on that moment: "It worked, I was hooked, and I joined the team."

Anthropic released the tool in research preview in February 2025, announcing it in a brief demo video that featured Wu and Cherny.

The two decamped to AI coding startup Cursor that summer, and then returned to Anthropic a couple of weeks later, The Information reported.

Wu and Cherny then oversaw Claude Code's meteoric rise, which ramped up at the end of 2025. The tool first grew popular as an automatic coder for software engineers, who suddenly had a product that could sprint through entire coding tasks. Tech giants' AI bills with Anthropic soared as more developers started burning through Claude tokens.

Wu also oversees Cowork, Anthropic's tool for non-coding work, which relies on the same AI models and handles knowledge work for non-software engineers.

Want more Business Insider in your news feed? Add BI in Google so our reporting is easier to find when you’re searching for what matters.

In an interview on Lenny's Podcast in April, Wu described her role as figuring out the path to bring Claude Code to the "AGI-pilled" version that Cherny envisioned for the future — a reference to the industry term "artificial general intelligence."

In her role, Wu said she worked with marketing, sales, finance, and other teams, and hired some of Anthropic's product managers. She also regularly responded to user requests about Claude Code on social media.

吴没有透露是什么促使她离开，也没有立即回应置评请求。她在 Anthropic 的关键时刻离开，该公司正准备在本月晚些时候进行大规模的首次公开募股。公司确认了她的离职。曾在 Claude Code 工作过的 Thariq Shihipar 于上个月宣布离职。

Wu 于 2024 年夏天加入 Anthropic，并测试了 Claude Code 的早期原型。在周二的帖子中，她回忆了那一刻：“它成功了，我被迷住了，我加入了这个团队。”

Anthropic 于 2025 年 2 月在研究预览版中发布了该工具，并在 Wu 和 Cherny 主演的简短演示视频中宣布了该工具。

据 The Information 报道，那年夏天，两人跳槽到了人工智能编码初创公司 Cursor，几周后又回到了 Anthropic。

随后，Wu 和 Cherny 见证了 Claude Code 的迅速崛起，并于 2025 年底迅速崛起。该工具最初作为软件工程师的自动编码器而流行，他们突然拥有了一款可以冲刺完成整个编码任务的产品。随着越来越多的开发者开始销毁 Claude 代币，科技巨头在 Anthropic 上的人工智能费用飙升。

Wu 还负责监管 Cowork，这是 Anthropic 的非编码工作工具，它依赖于相同的人工智能模型，并为非软件工程师处理知识工作。

title: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to "up to 12 business days", instead of the usual 3-5 days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
title_en: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to "up to 12 business days", instead of the usual 3-5 days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
author: The Verge
article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Valve admits that it’s now taking ‘up to 12 business days’ to review games.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

In a new post today, Valve acknowledged that it’s seen “a significant increase in submissions for store and page review in recent months” and says it’s “running a little behind” by taking “up to 12 business days” for reviews instead of the typical 3-5 days.

Indie developers have recently expressed frustrations over lengthy approval times for Steam games, even causing some games to miss planned launch dates. Valve says that “much” of the delay is having to re-review games, so it’s making some changes to the release checklist for developers to hopefully “cut down on re-reviews for basic functional issues.”

The changes include requiring developers to run games through Steam for at least five minutes. “Believe it or not, sometimes we review builds that have not ever been played through Steam,” Valve says. “This means that even if a game runs smoothly when a dev launches their executable directly, they might have missed basic steps that would impact a user installing and playing via Steam.”

Other requirements include making sure that achievements are ready and confirming any required common redistributables, like DirectX or Visual C++, that Steam may need to install.

Valve also says more improvements are in the works for the build review process.

title_zh: Steam游戏审核大排队
summary_zh: 由于开发者提交数量暴增，Steam审核周期延长至12个工作日，官方正通过强制测试要求来优化流程
article_content_zh:
该主题的帖子将添加到您的每日电子邮件摘要和主页源中。

Valve 承认现在需要“最多 12 个工作日”来审核游戏。

该作者的帖子将添加到您的每日电子邮件摘要和主页源中。

在今天的一篇新帖子中，Valve 承认“近几个月来提交的商店和页面审核数量显着增加”，并表示“有点落后”，审核需要“最多 12 个工作日”，而不是通常的 3-5 天。

独立开发者最近对 Steam 游戏审批时间过长表示不满，甚至导致一些游戏错过了计划的发布日期。 Valve 表示，延迟的“大部分”是因为必须重新审查游戏，因此它正在对开发者的发行清单进行一些更改，以期“减少对基本功能问题的重新审查”。

这些变化包括要求开发者通过 Steam 运行游戏至少五分钟。 “不管你信不信，有时我们会审查那些从未在 Steam 上玩过的版本，”Valve 说道。 “这意味着，即使开发者直接启动可执行文件时游戏运行顺利，他们也可能错过了影响用户通过 Steam 安装和玩游戏的基本步骤。”

其他要求包括确保成就已准备就绪，并确认 Steam 可能需要安装的任何必需的常见可再发行组件，例如 DirectX 或 Visual C++。

Valve 还表示，构建审核流程的更多改进正在进行中。

To clear the backlog, they are now mandating that developers verify their builds by running them through the Steam client for at least five minutes to minimize avoidable re-reviews.

Canva will cut more than 1000 jobs in a major restructure in response to slowing growth at the design giant.

Co-founder and chief executive Melanie Perkins told staff on Wednesday the Sydney design company needed to “refound Canva” and return to small, empowered teams after its growth slowed this year for the first time in a decade. The shake-up will affect 1271 jobs, or 22 per cent of its workforce, with some staff to lose their roles and others asked to relocate to centralised hubs.

Canva co-founders Cliff Obrecht, Melanie Perkins and Cameron Adams.Bloomberg“This is without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history,” she wrote.

“After exploring a wide range of alternatives, I’ve come to the difficult conclusion that small changes won’t be enough. To set ourselves up for the next decade, we need to refound Canva, getting back to our roots of small, empowered teams with the freedom to make decisions, take ownership, and focus on what matters most for our community.”

Canva will merge its product, growth and platform teams into a single product organisation and cut management layers. Sydney will become the primary home for more product teams, and hybrid staff will be expected in the office two to three days a week from January.

The shake-up comes as investor fears that AI will undercut software businesses have hammered design companies. Shares in rival Figma more than halved in 2026 to the end of April, despite strong revenue growth.

Blackbird, Canva’s biggest venture backer, cut its valuation of the company by 17 per cent to $US34.9 billion in August, with Airtree making the same cut from the $US42 billion set in a 2025 employee share sale. Canva’s own internal valuation fell to $US31 billion, this masthead revealed in August.

Canva 将在重大重组中裁员 1000 多人，以应对这家设计巨头增长放缓的情况。

联合创始人兼首席执行官 Melanie Perkins 周三告诉员工，这家悉尼设计公司在今年增长十年来首次放缓后，需要“重新组建 Canva”并回归小型、授权的团队。此次人事变动将影响 1271 个工作岗位，占员工总数的 22%，部分员工将失去职位，其他员工则被要求搬迁到集中中心。

Canva 联合创始人 Cliff Obrecht、Melanie Perkins 和 Cameron Adams。彭博社“这无疑是我们十三年历史上最艰难的时刻，”她写道。

“在探索了广泛的替代方案之后，我得出了一个艰难的结论：小小的改变是不够的。为了为下一个十年做好准备，我们需要重新建立 Canva，回到我们的小而授权团队的根源，让他们可以自由地做出决策、掌握所有权并专注于对我们社区最重要的事情。”

Canva 将把其产品、增长和平台团队合并为一个产品组织，并削减管理层。悉尼将成为更多产品团队的主要所在地，从一月份开始，混合型员工预计每周在办公室工作两到三天。

此次重组发生之际，投资者担心人工智能将削弱软件业务，这给设计公司带来了沉重打击。尽管收入增长强劲，但截至 2026 年 4 月底，竞争对手 Figma 的股价将减少一半以上。

Canva 最大的风险投资公司 Blackbird 在 8 月份将该公司的估值下调了 17%，至 349 亿美元，Airtree 在 2025 年员工股票出售中设定的 420 亿美元也进行了同样的削减。该报头在 8 月份透露，Canva 的内部估值已降至 310 亿美元。

离职员工将获得至少六个月的工资、Canva 提供的 12 个月的医疗保健，并且可以保留他们的工作 MacBook。他们还可以申请 10,000 美元（14,500 美元）的补助金来创办自己的企业。

title: Revolut says it cut AI coding inference costs by ~90% in less than a year by making self-hosted GLM models its default over commercial tools like Claude Code (Tobias Mann/The Register)
title_en: Revolut says it cut AI coding inference costs by ~90% in less than a year by making self-hosted GLM models its default over commercial tools like Claude Code (Tobias Mann/The Register)
author: The Register

Tobias Mann Tobias Mann SYSTEMS EDITOR Published tue 3 Nov 2026 // 20:07 UTC Make us preferred on Google READ MORE Nvidia is happy to take your money whether you're using open or closed models, says Jensen Huang 17 minutes ago Drax wants to feed Britain's AI habit with £20B datacenter at biomass power station 7 hours ago Toyota shows off SoC that stores model weights and its OS on integrated memory 17 hours ago Anthropic's compute tab could top $1T as Q3 revenue nears $17B 21 hours ago Marvell wants to be a copper topper, bets $115B on photonics leader to push optical networking 1 day ago Revolut says that in less than a year it's managed to slash its AI coding inference costs by roughly 90 percent by making self-hosted models its default instead of relying primarily on commercial services like Claude.

Speaking at the AI Engineer conference in New York last month, David Abitbol, ops and infrastructure lead at the British fintech, described how it saw a 60 percent improvement in coding time and a 70 percent improvement in lead time following its rollout of AI coding tools to roughly 2,000 engineers. Revolut initially adopted GLM-5.1 before moving to GLM-5.3, which it now serves using 56 Nvidia B200 GPUs.

Prior to its switch to GLM, Revolut had been experimenting with AI, deploying Gemini in early 2025 and Claude Code in early 2026. "We were highly skeptical about the cost of AI. We were seeing engineers spend $1,000 a month, $10,000 a month with not so much ROI, and so when we launched it we launched it with strict budget limits," Abitbol said.

Because of this, engineers only had access to a limited number of tokens, so the company began investigating self-hosting iyd own models. At $0.30 per million input/output tokens, self hosting GLM 5.1 cost about a tenth of using OpenAI's Codex or Anthropic's Claude Code. And, as it turned out, when tokens are cheap, you stop worrying about how many they use or what they use them for.

article_content_zh:
Tobias Mann Tobias Mann 系统编辑 发布于 2026 年 11 月 3 日星期二// 20:07 UTC 让我们在 Google 上成为首选 阅读更多 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 表示，无论您使用的是开放式模型还是封闭式模型，Nvidia 都很乐意接受您的钱 17 分钟前 Drax 希望在生物质发电站利用价值 20B 英镑的数据中心满足英国的人工智能习惯 7 小时前 丰田展示了将模型权重及其操作系统存储在集成内存中的 SoC 17 小时前 Anthropic 的计算选项卡可能会突破 1T 美元，因为第三季度收入接近 17B 美元 21 小时前 Marvell 希望成为铜领先者，在光子学领导者上押注 115B 美元以推动光网络 1 天前 Revolut 表示，在不到一年的时间里，通过将自托管模型设置为默认值，而不是主要依赖 Claude 等商业服务，它已成功将其 AI 编码推理成本削减了约 90%。

上个月在纽约举行的人工智能工程师会议上，英国金融科技公司运营和基础设施负责人 David Abitbol 描述了在向大约 2,000 名工程师推出人工智能编码工具后，编码时间缩短了 60%，交付周期缩短了 70%。 Revolut 最初采用 GLM-5.1，然后转向 GLM-5.3，现在使用 56 个 Nvidia B200 GPU 提供服务。

在转向 GLM 之前，Revolut 一直在尝试人工智能，于 2025 年初部署 Gemini，并于 2026 年初部署 Claude Code。“我们对人工智能的成本非常怀疑。我们看到工程师每月花费 1,000 美元，每月花费 10,000 美元，投资回报率并不高，因此当我们推出它时，我们在严格的预算限制下推出了它，”Abitbol 说。

因此，工程师只能访问有限数量的代币，因此该公司开始研究自托管 iyd 自己的模型。以每百万输入/输出代币 0.30 美元计算，自托管 GLM 5.1 的成本约为使用 OpenAI 的 Codex 或 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 的十分之一。而且，事实证明，当代币便宜时，你就不再担心它们使用了多少或它们用于什么目的。

虽然 Revolut 确实看到了编码速度的提高，但 Abitbol 指出最大的瓶颈实际上并不是代码。相反，他表示最大的收益来自于让人工智能模型处理诸如调试、Jira 和 Confluence 票证之类的事情。 “当你拥有无限的代币时，你就可以自由地这样做，”他说。 “你不再需要为季度末或最困难的任务保存代币。”

GLM 5.1 由中国开放权重模型开发者 Z.ai 开发，并不是一个小模型。该模型总共大约有 7540 亿个参数（每个生成的令牌激活 400 亿个参数），仅需要大约 380 GB 的 GPU 内存来保存权重，每个用户还需要 6-26 GB 的内存来根据精度维护上下文。

为了大规模服务 GLM-5.3，Revolut 部署了 56 个 Nvidia B200 GPU，其 GPU 数量相当于七个 8 个 GPU DGX B200 系统。但正如 Abitbol 指出的那样，最大的性能提升并不是来自添加 GPU，而是调整模型的超参数以及切换到 NVFP4 量化、实现分解的预填充和解码以及调整上下文长度。

一个关键要点是，支持一百万个令牌上下文窗口并不一定会使如此大的窗口有用或高效。 “长上下文是一个骗局。你真的需要注意这一点，”阿比特博尔说。 “尽管你可以提供 100 万个代币，但 256 [千]...

title: AMD reports Q3 revenue up 45% YoY to $13.38B, vs. $13.09B est., Data Center revenue up 97% to $8.5B, forecasts Q4 revenue above est.; AMD jumps 7%+ after hours (Katie Tarasov/CNBC)
title_en: AMD reports Q3 revenue up 45% YoY to $13.38B, vs. $13.09B est., Data Center revenue up 97% to $8.5B, forecasts Q4 revenue above est.; AMD jumps 7%+ after hours (Katie Tarasov/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Advanced Micro Devices reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday that beat Wall Street's expectations, with revenue jump 45% and data center sales nearly doubling from a year earlier. The stock jumped 7% in extended trading.

Revenue increased from $9.25 billion a year earlier, AMD said in a statement.

CEO Lisa Su said in a press release that she expects growth in data center processors to "accelerate further," and that meeting demand won't be a problem.

"With our leadership product portfolio and deep customer and supply chain relationships, we are confident in our ability to sustain very strong revenue growth and expanding profitability over the coming years " Su said in a statement.

AMD's report comes days after Intel disclosed similar data center growth, with revenue in that segment up 78% in the third quarter. But the stock plummeted 29% on Friday over concerns about weak guidance and Intel's ability to meet demand.

The data center unit makes up the majority of AMD's business, accounting for 64% of overall revenue, up from 47% a year ago.

After years spent chasing Nvidia in the market for artificial intelligence graphics processing units, or GPUs, AMD's central processing units, or CPUs, are experiencing a major resurgence with the rise of agentic AI apps like Meta's Muse. AMD's server CPUs are key for agentic apps because they power virtual machines and can run for hours on their own. Demand from agentic AI boosted AMD shares to a record in October.

AMD's stock is up about 125% this year, but it saw three consecutive days of losses before rallying on Tuesday amid an industrywide sell-off tied to fears about overspending on AI.

AMD is also a major player the in weakening PC market, which Intel blamed for its poor outlook last week. AMD and Intel are the largest makers of traditional x86 processors that power many laptops and desktops, while other laptops rely on Arm-based processors from the likes of Qualcomm and Apple.

article_content_zh:
Advanced Micro Devices 周二公布的第三季度财报超出了华尔街的预期，收入增长 45%，数据中心销售额同比增长近一倍。该股在盘后交易中上涨了 7%。

AMD 在一份声明中表示，营收较上年同期的 92.5 亿美元有所增长。

首席执行官苏姿丰(Lisa Su)在一份新闻稿中表示，她预计数据中心处理器的增长将“进一步加速”，满足需求不会成为问题。

苏在一份声明中表示：“凭借我们领先的产品组合以及深厚的客户和供应链关系，我们有信心在未来几年保持强劲的收入增长和不断扩大的盈利能力。”

AMD 发布报告的几天前，英特尔公布了类似的数据中心增长情况，第三季度该领域的收入增长了 78%。但由于对疲弱的指引和英特尔满足需求的能力的担忧，该股周五暴跌 29%。

数据中心部门构成了 AMD 业务的大部分，占总收入的 64%，高于一年前的 47%。

经过多年在人工智能图形处理单元（GPU）市场上追赶 Nvidia 后，随着 Meta 的 Muse 等代理人工智能应用程序的兴起，AMD 的中央处理单元（CPU）正在经历一次重大复苏。 AMD 的服务器 CPU 是代理应用程序的关键，因为它们为虚拟机提供动力，并且可以自行运行数小时。代理人工智能的需求推动 AMD 股价在 10 月份创下历史新高。

AMD 的股价今年上涨了约 125%，但由于担心人工智能超支而引发全行业抛售，该公司股价连续三天下跌，然后在周二反弹。

AMD 也是疲软的个人电脑市场的主要参与者，英特尔上周将其糟糕的前景归咎于 PC 市场。 AMD 和英特尔是传统 x86 处理器的最大制造商，为许多笔记本电脑和台式机提供动力，而其他笔记本电脑则依赖高通和苹果等公司基于 Arm 的处理器。

Counterpoint Research 的数据显示，由于内存和其他组件成本飙升，第二季度全球个人电脑出货量同比下降 4%。

AMD 报告了 PC 芯片与游戏芯片领域的销售额。该业务的收入较上年同期下降 8%，至 37 亿美元。游戏收入同比下降 40%。

据 LSEG 称，AMD 预计第四季度营收约为 170 亿美元，超过分析师平均预期 162 亿美元。据 StreetAccount 称，AMD 预计本季度毛利率为 55%，略低于平均预期 55.3%。

AMD 还销售数据中心 GPU 和名为 Helios 的全机架规模系统，与 Nvidia 的 Grace Blackwell 和 Vera Rubin 直接竞争。 Meta、Microsoft、Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Oracle 都开始在其数据中心使用 AMD Helios。 Meta 上周表示，其 Helios 机架已启动并运行，AMD 同意向 Meta 的股票发行投资 10 亿美元。

AMD 还承诺向 Anthropic 投资高达 50 亿美元，该公司上周公布了备受期待的招股说明书，距离潜在的历史性首次公开募股越来越近。

title: Anthropic releases FlashProve, open-source code that cryptographically verifies an AI response came from a given model, not a cheaper one swapped in by a router (Anthropic)
title_en: Anthropic releases FlashProve, open-source code that cryptographically verifies an AI response came from a given model, not a cheaper one swapped in by a router (Anthropic)
author: Anthropic
article_content:
Roy Rinberg (Anthropic), Alex Allain (Anthropic); Alessandro Chiesa (EPFL, StarkWare), Miranda Christ (MIT, RESI), Rahul Dalal (Anthropic STEM Fellows Program, Succinct), Giacomo Fenzi (EPFL), Ben Mayer (Anthropic Fellows Program, MIT), Guy Weissenberg (EPFL)

When you talk to a friend in person, you have many ways to know it is really them: you can see them, hear them, shake their hand. When you talk to an AI model, you have almost none. A user querying a model today cannot check that the responses came from the specific model that a developer claims is responding, as opposed to one secretly substituted in by a routing service for cost reasons, or even by an attacker who has tampered with the token stream. Judging from the model’s output alone is unreliable, even if it produces high-quality responses. Cryptographic proofs of inference solve this problem: they let a model provider commit to a model and then prove that each response was produced by that model. Such proofs could enable applications ranging from consumer products to internal security, and could contribute to a toolkit for verifying compliance with AI pacing requirements.

Specifically, we have made progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a “zkSNARK”, which is uniquely fit for provable inference (owing to its strong hiding and efficiency properties). In this post, we share some of that progress, primarily through a system we call FlashProve. A brief technical summary is as follows:

We release our code, Lean proofs, and documentation under the Apache 2.0 license.1 This research post is meant to share intermediate progress, and not a completed research agenda. We are sharing this explicitly with the goal that others look at what we have done, take it, and improve it.

article_content_zh:
罗伊·林伯格（人类）、亚历克斯·阿兰（人类）； Alessandro Chiesa（洛桑联邦理工学院、StarkWare）、Miranda Christ（麻省理工学院、RESI）、Rahul Dalal（人类 STEM 研究员计划，简明）、Giacomo Fenzi（洛桑联邦理工学院）、Ben Mayer（人类研究员计划，麻省理工学院）、Guy Weissenberg（洛桑联邦理工学院）

当您亲自与朋友交谈时，您可以通过多种方式知道那确实是他们：您可以看到他们、听到他们、与他们握手。当你与人工智能模型交谈时，你几乎什么也没有。今天查询模型的用户无法检查响应是否来自开发人员声称正在响应的特定模型，而不是出于成本原因被路由服务秘密替换的模型，甚至是被篡改令牌流的攻击者替换的模型。仅从模型的输出来看是不可靠的，即使它产生了高质量的响应。加密推理证明解决了这个问题：它们让模型提供者提交一个模型，然后证明每个响应都是由该模型生成的。此类证明可以支持从消费产品到内部安全的各种应用，并有助于构建用于验证是否符合人工智能节奏要求的工具包。

具体来说，我们在一种称为“zkSNARK”的强大加密证明方面取得了进展，它特别适合可证明的推理（由于其强大的隐藏性和效率特性）。在这篇文章中，我们主要通过我们称为 FlashProve 的系统分享了其中的一些进展。简要技术总结如下：

我们在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布我们的代码、精益证明和文档。1 这篇研究文章旨在分享中间进展，而不是完整的研究议程。我们明确分享这一点的目的是让其他人看看我们所做的事情，接受并改进它。

当用户向人工智能模型发送请求时，他们现在无法确定他们选择的模型是否是生成响应的模型。对于日常使用，用户最关心的是输出，而不一定是哪个特定模型产生的，这是一个不太紧迫的问题。但在某些情况下，这种保证是有用的。例如，在发布之前和之后测试人工智能模型的独立评估者需要知道他们正在评估的模型是正在服务的模型。通过第三方路由服务使用模型的客户希望确保代币来自他们支付的模型。如果网络攻击者在冒充给定模型的同时修改了令牌流，则用户无法仅从输出中检测到它。

然而，验证模型响应具有挑战性。大多数前沿模型的权重都是保密的，即使用户可以访问权重，检查给定的响应是否是由具有这些权重的模型生成的也需要运行模型，这需要的计算资源远远超出了典型用户（甚至评估者）可以承受的范围。

可证明推理 (PI) 的目标是使计算资源有限且没有任何权重信息的用户能够验证响应是否来自所请求的模型。 PI 的动机不仅是希望增加客户对人工智能提供商的信任，而且因为它可以用来向独立评估者提供保证，并允许提供商证明他们正在履行某些承诺和法律义务，它还对人工智能开发前沿和人工智能监管产生影响。

实现 PI 的一种方法是通过称为零知识简洁参数的加密对象：模型提供者与声明的响应一起发送一个简短的证明（例如，几兆字节），用户可以快速验证（理想情况下，在 CPU 上只需几秒钟）。如果声称的响应偏离指定模型，则用户的检查将失败。重要的是，加密技术确保证明不会透露任何有关模型权重的信息。

今天，我们发布了 FlashProve：一个用于可证明推理的开源高性能原型。对于 400B 参数混合专家模型（Llama 4 Maverick，4 位量化），我们表明单个 H100 GPU 以超过 100 个令牌/秒的速度生成证明，每个 1,024 个令牌请求的证明大小约为 19 MB（大约是常见开源库 vLLM 处理相同长度提示所需的 GPU 时间的 70-95 倍）。

title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
title_en: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps. As part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday, Apple announced developers can now integrate Siri AI's new features in "all apps," allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user's personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on-screen awareness to complete requests.

此次更新不仅是接口层面的开放，更是苹果对iOS交互逻辑的一次彻底重构。通过赋予Siri跨应用调用的能力，苹果试图将AI直接植入到操作系统的毛细血管中，从而在激烈的AI硬件竞争中守住生态壁垒。

开发者被要求配置特定的“技能包”，这意味着未来Siri将不再只是单纯的听指令，而是能够理解用户在屏幕上所见的内容，并主动关联后台服务。这一举措标志着苹果正在试图通过高度整合的AI中台，反向定义移动操作系统的交互范式。

title: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers with iOS 27.3 and other 27.3 OS betas, letting any app bring its content and actions into Siri AI by using App Intents (Apple Developer)
title_en: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers with iOS 27.3 and other 27.3 OS betas, letting any app bring its content and actions into Siri AI by using App Intents (Apple Developer)
author: Apple Developer
article_content:
Starting today with the iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3, and visionOS 27.3 betas, a new Developer Preview enables any developer to integrate their app with Siri AI, giving businesses and developers new ways to reach and serve their customers.

Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal, is designed to be deeply integrated into Apple’s operating systems and the apps people use every day, including the apps from our vast ecosystem of developers. Thousands of developers have already built integrations with Siri to let users ask for directions, manage a to-do list, send a message, or catch up on an audiobook. Siri AI is available in many languages, including English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish and will soon expand to support Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese. People around the world are turning to Siri AI to get things done every day, which means more customers can discover and use apps just by asking.

Today’s preview allows any app to bring its content and actions directly into Siri AI by using App Intents, making it easier for all apps to tap into Siri AI’s newest capabilities, including personal context understanding, onscreen awareness, natural language, and more. So people can just ask for help in their own words, and Siri AI carries out any custom action you’ve built, from checking a delivery to booking a reservation to placing an order. For complex requests, we’re also introducing skills to let you teach Siri AI how to combine several actions into a single experience. And Siri AI can now surface any entity in the Spotlight semantic index, not just the ones that fit an existing schema.

We started rolling out these new capabilities across many Apple apps, including Calendar, Files, Finder, Journal, Mail, Maps, Messages, Music, Notes, Photos, Preview, Reminders, Safari, Shortcuts, and Weather, so users can do things like find a coffee shop they visited last w...

article_content_zh:
从今天开始，从 iOS 27.3、iPadOS 27.3、macOS 27.3 和 VisionOS 27.3 Beta 版开始，新的开发者预览版使任何开发者都可以将其应用程序与 Siri AI 集成，为企业和开发者提供接触和服务客户​​的新方式。

Siri AI 是 Siri 的全新版本，功能更加强大、更具对话性和个性化，旨在深度集成到 Apple 的操作系统和人们每天使用的应用程序中，包括来自我们庞大的开发者生态系统的应用程序。成千上万的开发者已经与 Siri 建立了集成，让用户可以询问方向、管理待办事项列表、发送消息或收听有声读物。 Siri AI 支持多种语言，包括英语、法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语，并将很快扩展到支持繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语。世界各地的人们每天都在求助于 Siri AI 来完成工作，这意味着更多的客户只需询问即可发现和使用应用程序。

今天的预览版允许任何应用程序通过使用应用程序意图将其内容和操作直接引入 Siri AI，从而使所有应用程序更轻松地利用 Siri AI 的最新功能，包括个人上下文理解、屏幕感知、自然语言等。因此，人们只需用自己的话寻求帮助，Siri AI 就会执行您构建的任何自定义操作，从检查送货到预订再到下订单。对于复杂的请求，我们还引入了一些技能，让您可以教 Siri AI 如何将多个操作组合成一个体验。 Siri AI 现在可以显示 Spotlight 语义索引中的任何实体，而不仅仅是适合现有模式的实体。

我们开始在许多 Apple 应用程序中推出这些新功能，包括日历、文件、Finder、日记、邮件、地图、消息、音乐、笔记、照片、预览、提醒、Safari、快捷方式和天气，以便用户可以执行诸如查找上周访问过的咖啡店或归档一年多没有打开的文件等操作。现在还有更多操作示例可供您参考。要了解每个应用程序可以执行哪些操作，只需询问 Siri AI。

此开发者测试版让开发者可以一睹 Siri AI 应用意图。借助此早期开发者预览版，您的应用程序可以直接与 Siri AI 配合使用，让您首先了解接触和服务客户​​的新方法。此预览版提供了在几个月后首次发货给客户之前的早期访问；随着春季开放的 App Store 提交，开发人员有时间在发布前探索、构建和帮助塑造他们的体验。尝试一下并分享您的反馈。

当您尽早探索时，我们将跟进有关通过 Siri AI 实现的体验的条款和使用政策的更多详细信息。更多内容即将分享。

要了解有关新 API、如何使用它们以及如何评估应用程序使用 Siri AI 的体验的更多信息，请阅读新文档。您还可以于 11 月 4 日至 5 日与 Apple Intelligence Group Labs 的 Apple 工程师联系，提出问题、获取建议并关注讨论。

title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. A newer internal model scores significantly higher on OpenAI's engineering benchmark, though the company isn't sharing details.

The article OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week appeared first on The Decoder.

title_zh: OpenAI用GPT-6一周搞定硬件设计
summary_zh: OpenAI利用GPT-6 Astra模型，在不到一周时间内完成了从外壳到电路板的硬件设备全流程设计

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI内部硬件团队利用GPT-6 Astra模型，在不到一周时间内独立完成了Codex编码代理所需硬件设备的完整设计。该过程涵盖了从外观结构、电路板布局到固件编写的全周期，尽管生产前经历了数次因制造公差问题导致的调整，但这一成果验证了AI介入复杂工业研发的可行性。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI's hardware team utilized the GPT-6 Astra model to design the hardware for the Codex coding agent in under a week. The process covered the entire cycle from enclosure and PCB layout to firmware, and despite multiple revisions due to manufacturing tolerances, it successfully validated the feasibility of AI-driven industrial engineering.

elements_zh.where: OpenAI实验室研发场景
elements_zh.what: 使用GPT-6 Astra模型在不到一周内完成硬件研发设计
elements_zh.why: 验证大模型在工业制造与复杂工程任务中的研发辅助能力

elements_en.what: Completed hardware R&D in under a week using GPT-6 Astra
elements_en.why: To validate the capability of LLMs in industrial manufacturing and complex engineering tasks

ai_analysis.insight_en: Sam Altman is basically sending hardware engineers and industrial designers on an indefinite vacation. When the model starts drawing circuit boards on its own, the only thing left for humans to do is to pull the plug if the printer jams.

title: A look at efforts by OpenAI, Anthropic, and others to prevent anyone from using their AI tools to disrupt midterms, including Anthropic's first-ever "war room" (Steven Lee Myers/New York Times)
title_en: A look at efforts by OpenAI, Anthropic, and others to prevent anyone from using their AI tools to disrupt midterms, including Anthropic's first-ever "war room" (Steven Lee Myers/New York Times)
author: New York Times
content_snippet: OpenAI, Anthropic and other tech companies have vowed to protect Tuesday's elections from efforts to undermine democracy.
summary_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI giants are intensifying safeguards against AI-driven election interference. Anthropic has launched its first-ever 'war room' to monitor and intercept deepfakes and manipulative content, aiming to prevent the abuse of their tools during the election cycle.
title_zh: AI大厂集结迎战选举干扰
summary_zh: OpenAI与Anthropic等科技公司采取严厉管控措施，通过设立“战情室”等手段防止AI工具被滥用于干扰选举

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI与Anthropic等头部AI厂商针对即将到来的选举周期，升级了防范AI工具造假和干扰的审查机制。其中，Anthropic首次设立了实时响应的“战情室”进行监控，旨在通过算法拦截与内容合规策略，遏制深度伪造内容和操纵性信息的蔓延。

Anthropic has launched its first-ever 'war room' to monitor and intercept deepfakes and manipulative content, aiming to prevent the abuse of their tools during the election cycle.

title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
title_en: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest.

The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.
content_snippet:
Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest.

The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: Stanford researchers analyzed 50 widely cited claims about LLMs, finding that 44% are obsolete and 34% have significantly weakened, with an average shelf life of just 15.7 months. Claims about model limitations become irrelevant fastest, proving that LLM evolution is outpacing the pace of academic research.
title_zh: AI研究的寿命竟不足16个月
summary_zh: 斯坦福研究指出，由于AI迭代过快，近8成关于LLM能力的论文结论在短时间内即告“过期”或失效

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 斯坦福研究人员对比分析了50项关于大语言模型的权威研究，发现约44%的结论已完全失效，34%的结论效力显著减弱，平均有效期仅为15.7个月。其中，关于“模型不能做什么”的论断失效速度最快，反映出AI技术的进化速度已彻底碾压了学术界对其进行解释和归纳的能力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Stanford researchers analyzed 50 widely cited claims about LLMs, finding that 44% are obsolete and 34% have significantly weakened, with an average shelf life of just 15.7 months. Claims about model limitations become irrelevant fastest, proving that LLM evolution is outpacing the pace of academic research.

elements_zh.where: AI模型能力测评领域
elements_zh.what: 揭示了AI研究结论的极高淘汰率，平均有效期仅为15.7个月
elements_zh.why: 由于大语言模型更新换代过快，导致静态研究滞后于模型进化速度

elements_en.what: High obsolescence rate of AI research findings, with an average lifespan of only 15.7 months
elements_en.why: Rapid model iteration outpaces the pace of academic inquiry

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 在AI圈发论文简直是在玩‘打地鼠’，前脚刚论证模型智力天花板，后脚就被模型的新版本扇了脸。与其说是科研，不如说是在给不断进化、随时背刺人类常识的数字怪物写遗书。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Publishing AI research right now is like playing a game of 'Whac-A-Mole'—you prove a model's limits, and by the time it hits the printer, the next update has already made you look like a clown. It’s not so much science as it is writing obituaries for AI capabilities that are constantly evolving to spite us.

It’s not so much science as it is writing obituaries for AI capabilities that are constantly evolving to spite us.

article_content_zh:
斯坦福大学的研究人员针对 20 个当前模型测试了 50 个被广泛引用的有关法学硕士的说法。 44% 的研究结果已经“过期”，另外 34% 的研究结果已显着减弱。平均寿命只有15.7个月。关于模型不能做什么的声明很快就会失效。

研究发现，《快速法学硕士发展正在超越旨在解释它的研究》一文首先出现在解码器上。

【关键数据与实测】研究结论平均有效期仅15.7个月。

title: Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
title_en: Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
author: The Verge AI
article_content: Starting today, Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with Audio Intelligence features that are available in the new watchOS 27.3 developer beta rolling out now. The two new additions are Siri Recap, which uses "ambient listening" to generate summaries of your conversation, and Live Rewind, which generates text transcripts of the last 15 seconds of audio your watch's mic detected.
content_snippet: Starting today, Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with Audio Intelligence features that are available in the new watchOS 27.3 developer beta rolling out now. The two new additions are Siri Recap, which uses "ambient listening" to generate summaries of your conversation, and Live Rewind, which generates text transcripts of the last 15 seconds of audio your watch's mic detected.
summary_en: Apple introduced 'Audio Intelligence' features in its latest watchOS developer beta, enabling Siri to generate conversation summaries and live transcriptions of the last 15 seconds of audio. This move aims to push AI dialogue management to the wrist, leveraging persistent microphone monitoring to enhance intelligent daily life tracking.

title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
title_en: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google.

Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said the company defines a search as any time a user inputs a query that results in a web search, as opposed to tasks like defining a term or a simple how-to explanation. (Fry did not specify the source of the Google search volume number.)

title: Indie games are missing launch dates because Steam is backed up

article_content:

But the game is "still awaiting approval," forcing the team to delay the release, according to a post from game director Alfred Kamon.

summary_en: Steam's review efficiency has dropped significantly, leaving many game builds in pending status for extended periods. title_zh: Steam审核拥堵致独立游戏延期

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Steam平台近期审核效率大幅下降，导致开发者提交的构建版本长时间处于待审批状态。多家独立游戏工作室因错过既定的上线节点，被迫发布延期声明，这一瓶颈反映出平台在面对激增的游戏提交量时人工审核流程已不堪重负。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Steam's review efficiency has dropped significantly, leaving many game builds in pending status for extended periods. Numerous indie studios have been forced to delay their releases after missing scheduled launch windows, highlighting a bottleneck in the platform's manual review process amid surging submission volumes.

elements_zh.where: Steam游戏提交与审核平台

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 一边是G胖数钱数到手软，一边是开发者在审核队列里望穿秋水。看来Steam的审核团队还是20年前的配置，这不仅是生产力灾难，更是对独立游戏人心脏的极限挑战。
ai_analysis.insight_en: While Gabe is busy counting his billions, indie devs are drowning in a backlog. It seems Steam’s review team is still running on a 20-year-old operational model—a productivity disaster for the little guys.

许多独立游戏开发商最近在社交媒体上发帖称，他们在 Steam 上提交的游戏的审批等待时间出人意料地漫长，其中一些审批导致开发商错过了计划的发布日期。

例如，即将推出的游戏《Food Devils》的开发团队 Studio Daimon 在 10 月 12 日提交了版本后，原计划于今天推出抢先体验版游戏。但根据游戏总监阿尔弗雷德·卡蒙（Alfred Kamon）的帖子，该游戏“仍在等待批准”，迫使团队推迟发布。

title: Netflix will show you themed recommendations through a new ‘AI Discover’ tab
title_en: Netflix will show you themed recommendations through a new ‘AI Discover’ tab
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
Netflix's TV app is getting a new "AI Discover" tab where the company will show experimental, AI-powered features to help you find new shows and movies to watch.

The first of these experiments surfaces content based around themes, like "Something Light," "Family Movie Night," or "Quick Watches." When you pick a theme, Netflix will show you recommendations that match it. If you don't like a recommendation, you can tell that to Netflix, and the app will remember it.

The company says that AI Discover is powered by "a new intelligence layer we've been building that responds to what members tell us in real time and keeps learning."

title: Microsoft updates Windows 11 to make PCs with 8GB of RAM up to 20% more responsive and multitasking up to 40% faster in lab tests, utilizing memory compression (Lance Whitney/ZDNET)
title_en: Microsoft updates Windows 11 to make PCs with 8GB of RAM up to 20% more responsive and multitasking up to 40% faster in lab tests, utilizing memory compression (Lance Whitney/ZDNET)
author: ZDNET
article_content:
The latest updates to Windows 11 offer improvements in speed, performance, and memory management.

The more memory your Windows PC has, the faster it should perform, especially when juggling multiple apps, files, and other data. My laptop has 32GB of RAM, while my desktop has a hefty 64GB, and both are absolutely zippy. Does that mean computers with only 8GB of memory, or even less, are also-rans? Nope, not according to Microsoft.

Also: How much RAM does your PC really need?

In a new blog post published Tuesday, Microsoft touted the gains in speed, performance, and memory management in Windows 11 achieved by the latest updates. These especially impact PCs with just 8GB of RAM, which can now run multiple apps and files faster and more efficiently than before.

To reach this goal, the company said it had three notions in mind.

The first was to make better use of the existing memory on each Windows 11 PC. The second was to protect the tasks that need to feel instant even as more memory gets used. And the third was to ensure that key apps and Windows require less memory. Yes, a computer with 16GB, 32GB, or 64GB of RAM can better handle more intensive activities. But Microsoft wanted to make sure that systems with 8GB could also keep pace.

Based on its own lab tests of PCs with 8GB of RAM, the company claims that Windows is now 20% more responsive and that multitasking is 40% faster than before the latest updates. Here’s how.

As more memory gets allocated, Windows must move inactive apps and files from RAM to the hard drive. When you need to access those apps and files again, you have to wait for Windows to move them from disk storage back to RAM. Normally, PCs with less memory have to do a lot of this disk swapping.

article_content_zh:
Windows 11 的最新更新在速度、性能和内存管理方面进行了改进。

Windows PC 的内存越多，执行速度就越快，尤其是在处理多个应用程序、文件和其他数据时。我的笔记本电脑有 32GB 内存，而我的台式机有 64GB 内存，两者都非常快。这是否意味着内存只有 8GB 甚至更少的计算机都是失败者？不，根据微软的说法，不是。

另外：您的电脑真正需要多少内存？

在周二发布的一篇新博客文章中，微软宣传了最新更新在 Windows 11 中实现的速度、性能和内存管理方面的进步。这些对 RAM 仅有 8GB 的​​ PC 的影响尤为明显，这些 PC 现在可以比以前更快、更高效地运行多个应用程序和文件。

为了实现这一目标，该公司表示有三个想法。

首先是更好地利用每台 Windows 11 PC 上的现有内存。第二个是保护需要感觉即时的任务，即使使用更多内存也是如此。第三是确保关键应用程序和 Windows 需要更少的内存。是的，具有 16GB、32GB 或 64GB RAM 的计算机可以更好地处理更密集的活动。但微软希望确保 8GB 系统也能跟上步伐。

根据其自己对 8GB RAM 电脑的实验室测试，该公司声称 Windows 现在比最新更新之前的响应速度提高了 20%，多任务处理速度提高了 40%。方法如下。

随着分配更多内存，Windows 必须将不活动的应用程序和文件从 RAM 移动到硬盘驱动器。当您需要再次访问这些应用程序和文件时，您必须等待 Windows 将它们从磁盘存储移回 RAM。通常，内存较少的电脑必须进行大量的磁盘交换。

Windows 减轻此过程痛苦的一种方法是通过压缩。在这里，操作系统将不太活跃的数据缩小为较小的格式，以便它可以保留在内存中。尽管 Windows 已使用压缩多年，但 Microsoft 已对该技术进行了微调，以确定压缩程度、何时将数据从 RAM 移动到驱动器以及何时取回数据，尤其是在具有 8GB 内存的 PC 上。

微软表示，因此，Windows 现在可以在内存中保留最多 2GB 的活动数据，而不是将其移动到存储中。当您返回打开的非活动应用程序、文件或浏览器时，不太可能需要从硬盘驱动器重新加载。

打开“开始”菜单、启动文件资源管理器、右键单击文件夹或文件以及搜索项目都是需要即时完成的任务；否则，Windows 本身就会感觉迟缓。微软表示，为了在 RAM 较少的 PC 上实现这一目标，Windows 会尝试优先考虑需要完成的某些操作，同时放弃搜索索引等后台任务。

这是一个例子。更新计算机并重新启动后，Windows 需要执行一些内务处理工作。但发生的任何设置工作都不应影响打开应用程序或文件所需的时间。

据微软称，与 2026 年 1 月的版本相比，最新版本的 Windows 11 将此类任务和交互的速度提高了 20%。

然而，多任务处理对只有 8GB RAM 的 PC 造成的压力最大。为了分析这一点，微软表示，它在同一台 8GB 内存的 PC 上进行了两次测试。一项测试测量了 Windows 11 的当前版本，而另一项测试则测量了 2026 年 1 月的版本。测试人员在 Microsoft Edge 中打开了 20 个选项卡，开始播放 4K 视频，并在 Word、PowerPoint 和 Excel 中依次启动大文件。该公司表示，当前版本的 Windows 比其前身快 40%。

title: Rockstar plans to let users pre-load GTA VI on November 10, ahead of its November 19 launch, and says the game requires up to 212GB "depending on your device" (Emma Roth/The Verge)
title_en: Rockstar plans to let users pre-load GTA VI on November 10, ahead of its November 19 launch, and says the game requires up to 212GB "depending on your device" (Emma Roth/The Verge)
author: The Verge
article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Rockstar says to make sure you have ‘ample space’ on your device.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

You’re going to need a lot of extra storage space on your console if you’re planning to play Grand Theft Auto VI later this month. Rockstar Games confirmed on Tuesday that the pre-load file will require up to 212GB “depending on your device.”

Rockstar says you can start pre-loading the game on the PlayStation 5 on Tuesday, November 10th at midnight in your local time zone, while users on Xbox Series X | S devices can start pre-loading on November 10th at 12AM GMT. The company says to “make sure you’ve got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible.” Rockstar also posted a support page with more information about pre-loading the game.

The announcement lines up with recent rumors suggesting that the game could take up a significant amount of storage space. GTA VI launches on November 19th for $79.99 and is only available via digital download. Physical versions of the game will include just a code in the box.

title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
title_en: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time.

The article AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence appeared first on The Decoder.

title: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
title_en: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
author: Ars Technica
article_content:
In 2023, malware tracked as BlackLotus became the first publicly documented in-the-wild UEFI bootkit capable of bypassing Secure Boot on fully updated Windows 11 systems. With the industry-wide chain-of-trust mechanism subverted, the malware was able to run malicious code before Windows was fully loaded and many security defenses were operational.

Microsoft had already patched the vulnerability that BlackLotus exploited in 2022. In 2023 and 2024, Microsoft issued additional updates. The first added a new certificate that no longer trusted the vulnerable boot managers. The second provided the means to revoke trust in the digital certificate used to sign older vulnerable Windows boot managers. The organizations infected by the new bootkit, which is tracked under the name BlackX, had installed all of these patches. So how did they fall victim?

Before discussing the incident further, a brief review of BlackLotus and UEFI malware is in order. Short for Unified Extensible Firmware Interface, UEFI is firmware that runs immediately after a computer is turned on. One of its main jobs is to load system configuration settings, identify and initialize hardware components, and prepare the com

article_content:
Binance on Tuesday disclosed that North Korean hackers used a mix of social engineering and malicious software to pull off last week’s $6.3 billion heist, the biggest in crypto history. Speaking to reporters, company executives revealed that the hackers targeted a Binance engineer on LinkedIn and arranged a series of fake job interviews in order to persuade the employee to download an “assignment” that let them invade the company’s systems.

In a related report, Binance explained that: “Software Engineer B was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform by an individual posing as a Project Director. Software Engineer B had a profile on the platform that referenced his experience at Binance. The purported Project Director arranged a first-round interview with a HR representative, followed by a second-round interview with an individual claiming to be the CEO of a fictitious company.”

The report also provided additional details about the sophisticated months-long scheme that involved not only the fake LinkedIn recruitment, but also used a separate ad campaign that tricked another engineer into downloading a malicious version of a popular software package called Homebrew.

According to Binance, the engineer in question did not download the Homebrew software though the company’s regular channels, but instead clicked on an internet ad promoting a tampered version of it.

Binance says it detected the fake Homebrew download and removed it from the employee’s machine, but not before the hackers discovered critical information about the engineer’s role and others who managed the company’s wallets.

It was the combination of these exploits—the fake LinkedIn outreach and the knowledge gleaned from the tampered Homebrew download—that allowed the North Korean hackers to take over a series of Binance wallets and drain them of funds.

article_content_zh:
币安周二透露，朝鲜黑客利用社交工程和恶意软件的结合，上周完成了加密货币历史上最大的 63 亿美元盗窃案。公司高管在接受记者采访时透露，黑客针对 LinkedIn 上的一名币安工程师，安排了一系列虚假的工作面试，以说服该员工下载“任务”，从而入侵公司的系统。

币安在相关报告中解释道：“一名冒充项目总监的个人通过合法的求职平台联系了软件工程师 B。软件工程师 B 在该平台上有一份个人资料，其中提到了他在币安的经历。这位所谓的项目总监安排了与人力资源代表的第一轮面试，随后又安排了与自称是一家虚构公司首席执行官的个人的第二轮面试。”

该报告还提供了有关长达数月的复杂计划的更多细节，该计划不仅涉及虚假的 LinkedIn 招聘，还使用了单独的广告活动来欺骗另一名工程师下载名为 Homebrew 的流行软件包的恶意版本。

据币安称，该工程师并未通过该公司的常规渠道下载 Homebrew 软件，而是点击了宣传该软件被篡改版本的互联网广告。

币安表示，它检测到了虚假的 Homebrew 下载并将其从员工的计算机中删除，但在此之前，黑客发现了有关工程师角色和管理公司钱包的其他人的关键信息。

正是这些漏洞的结合——虚假的 LinkedIn 外展活动和从被篡改的 Homebrew 下载中收集的信息——使得朝鲜黑客能够接管一系列币安钱包并盗取其中的资金。

虽然许多人最初猜测黑客使用人工智能闯入币安，但该公司的账户显示他们主要依赖传统的网络钓鱼策略。同时，币安补充称，人工智能确实发挥了作用。当黑客在控制了工程师的笔记本电脑后，使用币安自己的内部人工智能工具来入侵其他帐户时，就发生了这种情况。“攻击者利用工程师 B 受感染的计算机，并使用内部人工智能工具来控制钱包 DevOps 工程师 A 和另一名钱包软件工程师 C。攻击者很快发现钱包 DevOps 工程师 A 在其计算机上拥有容器部署权限令牌，”币安报告称。

据币安发言人称，担任非公开角色的员工不得维护 LinkedIn 个人资料。该发言人拒绝解释相关工程师是否违反了该政策，或者其中任何一名工程师是否会被解雇。

朝鲜黑客冒充招聘人员的现象已成为整个企业界的一个普遍问题。就币安而言，该公司表示，其早先在 LinkedIn 上标记了黑客针对其员工的行为，并于 2026 年检测并阻止了 57 起与朝鲜相关的黑客企图。

自周四发生的几个小时的攻击以来，该公司披露黑客窃取了约 63 亿美元，但在 Tether 和 Circle 两家公司采取行动冻结被盗的稳定币后，该公司能够追回约 25 亿美元。

为了应对此次黑客攻击，币安关闭了提款功能约 48 小时，但于周六重新启用。该公司多次表示所有客户资金都是安全的，并已从储备金和其他来源补充了98%的被盗币。它正在收购剩余的 2%，其中包括较少使用的货币。

币安在一份声明中表示：“这种情况不应该发生，对于它给我们的用户、合作伙伴和更广泛的行业带来的担忧、干扰和不确定性，我们深表歉意。”

杰夫·约翰·罗伯茨 (Jeff John Roberts) 是《财富》杂志的金融和加密货币编辑，负责监督区块链的报道以及技术如何改变金融。

title: Midterm elections 2026: all the news
title_en: Midterm elections 2026: all the news
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
The 2026 midterm elections will determine the scope of President Donald Trump’s power in his final two years in office, and signal what voters care about going into the 2028 presidential election. While this year’s races are expected to be most broadly defined by affordability issues, there’s several topics impacting the tech industry that appear to be on voters’ minds.

Among them are concerns about data centers, and whether voters will have to bear the burden of higher energy costs, AI safety, and the rapid expansion of surveillance technology through Flock. There’s also the question of how to tax billionaires’ wealth in California, a topic that has driven heavy tech spending and creative stock class structures meant to keep tech executives from fleeing the state should a ballot measure pass.

The next Congress is likely to continue grappling with how to regulate AI, and stem the data center backlash, among other issues. How that conversation shapes up, and which tech CEOs are hauled to testify on Capitol Hill, will be shaped by the outcome of November 3rd.

title: ChatGPT Consumer Product Lead Adam Fry says ChatGPT has hit 1.2B WAUs, adding 200M over the past two months, and its search volume is now ~20% of Google's (Alex Kantrowitz/Big Technology)
title_en: ChatGPT Consumer Product Lead Adam Fry says ChatGPT has hit 1.2B WAUs, adding 200M over the past two months, and its search volume is now ~20% of Google's (Alex Kantrowitz/Big Technology)
author: Big Technology
article_content:
OpenAI says ChatGPT growth is accelerating.

The company added 200 million users over just the past two months, jumping from 1 billion to 1.2 billion weekly active users in 60 days. Its search volume, it says, is approximately 20% of Google’s. Its users create 1.5 billion images with it per week. And its voice mode, between dictation and speaking with ChatGPT, now has 250 million combined weekly active users.

ChatGPT consumer product lead Adam Fry told me this during a brief fireside chat at an OpenAI-hosted dinner in New York City on Monday night. “The growth is just going big,” he said.

During our conversation, Fry also revealed plans to merge ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes (so that confusing toggle up top will soon go away), agreed with feedback that ChatGPT-created restaurant signage looks too uniform, and addressed the cost to serve its personal assistant Dots.

Here’s a look at our full conversation, lightly edited for clarity and length. We also cover image generation, interactive interfaces, advertising, education, and public unease about AI:

Alex Kantrowitz: OpenAI has analyzed ChatGPT’s search volume and compared it with Google’s. What did you find?

Adam Fry: ChatGPT has been growing quite quickly. ChatGPT’s volume of search-like queries is now roughly one-fifth the volume of queries of Google.

It’s a pretty amazing statistic when you think about it, mainly because we started just about a year and a half ago. It’s hard to remember this, but ChatGPT at a time didn’t have any up-to-date information. You’d ask a question, it would say something like, “It’s past my training date,” and nobody had any idea what that meant.

You’re saying ChatGPT’s search volume is one-fifth of Google’s. Bing’s share of the search market is around 5%. Does that make you multiple times larger than Bing?

article_content_zh:
OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 的增长正在加速。

仅仅过去两个月，该公司就增加了 2 亿用户，60 天内每周活跃用户从 10 亿跃升至 12 亿。据称，其搜索量约为 Google 的 20%。它的用户每周用它创建 15 亿张图像。它的语音模式（介于听写和与 ChatGPT 交谈之间）目前每周活跃用户总数达到 2.5 亿。

周一晚上，ChatGPT 消费产品负责人 Adam Fry 在 OpenAI 于纽约举办的晚宴上进行简短的炉边聊天时告诉了我这一点。 “增长正在变得越来越大，”他说。

在我们的谈话中，Fry 还透露了合并 ChatGPT 的聊天和工作模式的计划（这样令人困惑的顶部切换很快就会消失），同意 ChatGPT 创建的餐厅标牌看起来过于统一的反馈，并解决了为其个人助理 Dots 提供服务的成本问题。

以下是我们的完整对话，为了清晰和长度而进行了轻微编辑。我们还涵盖图像生成、交互界面、广告、教育以及公众对人工智能的不安：

Alex Kantrowitz：OpenAI 分析了 ChatGPT 的搜索量，并将其与 Google 进行了比较。你发现了什么？

Adam Fry：ChatGPT 发展得相当快。 ChatGPT 的类似搜索查询量现在大约是 Google 查询量的五分之一。

仔细想想，这是一个非常惊人的统计数据，主要是因为我们大约一年半前才开始。很难记住这一点，但 ChatGPT 当时没有任何最新信息。你问一个问题，它会说“已经过了我的训练日期”，但没有人知道这意味着什么。

你是说 ChatGPT 的搜索量是 Google 的五分之一。 Bing 在搜索市场的份额约为 5%。这会让你比 Bing 规模大好几倍吗？

更直接地说，ChatGPT 在短短两个月内就从 10 亿增长到了 1.2。这意味着 30 天内大约有 1 亿用户，再过 30 天又增加 1 亿。增长速度很快，我们非常关注 ChatGPT 的增长速度。

什么算搜索？我可能会在 ChatGPT 对话中来回出现 20 个提示。每一个都算作一个查询吗？

进军高端市场意味着满足企业买家首先提出的要求：SSO、目录同步和审核日志。 WorkOS 为您提供了这三个功能，因此您的团队可以继续构建产品而不是清单。

Adam Fry：如果回溯到大约两年前，人们来到 ChatGPT 的目的实际上是编写帮助和编码帮助。这些并不是你真正寻找的东西。

去年我们看到人们已经开始关注所有这些其他话题。比如您正在查找一个人或多个人、一个地方或一件事，它需要最新的信息。这是一个关键要素。

title: Google plans to make it easier to restrict its AI tools for students in early 2027, but says schools that block AI entirely will lose student access to Search (New York Times)
title_en: Google plans to make it easier to restrict its AI tools for students in early 2027, but says schools that block AI entirely will lose student access to Search (New York Times)
author: New York Times
content_snippet: Google is making it easier to restrict its A.I. tools for students. But schools that block A.I. entirely will lose student access to Google's search engine.
summary_en: Google plans to introduce tools in early 2027 making it easier for schools to restrict AI use among students. However, the company simultaneously issued a strict mandate: schools that completely ban AI will also lose student access to Google Search, sparking educational backlash over technological bundling.
title_zh: 谷歌调整学生AI限制与搜索绑定
summary_zh: 谷歌计划于2027年初简化校园AI限制工具，但同时警告全面封禁AI工具的学校将失去学生搜索权限

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌计划在2027年初推出新功能，使学校更易于对学生限制其生成式AI工具的使用。然而，该公司也同步抛出了一项强硬政策：任何选择全面封禁AI工具的学校，也将同时剥夺学生使用谷歌网页搜索（Google Search）的权限，引发教育界对技术绑定的激烈争议。

However, the company simultaneously issued a strict mandate: schools that completely ban AI will also lose student access to Google Search, sparking educational backlash over technological bundling.

title: Apple is all in on AI — its own and everyone else’s
title_en: Apple is all in on AI — its own and everyone else’s
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
Apple's latest earnings show how it's continuing to capitalize on the AI boom without busting its budget on the infrastructure spending consuming its competitors.

Overall, Apple posted its best-ever fiscal year for revenue and earnings per share. iPhone and Mac sales continued to grow strongly in the fourth quarter. iPhone revenue rose 17.5% from a year earlier to a September quarter record of $57.6 billion while Mac revenue climbed 24% to $10.8 billion, its highest level in four years. Shares nevertheless fell in premarket trading Tuesday after Apple warned that rising memory costs would squeeze its profit margins in the holiday quarter.

title: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary, gaining bipartisan reach just as midterms loom
title_en: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary, gaining bipartisan reach just as midterms loom
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI hires Dan Driscoll, the former civilian head of the US Army, as "Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization," likely to win government contracts and help shape AI rules for the military and intelligence agencies. Driscoll drove AI projects inside the Army, is a close ally of Vice President JD Vance, and yet maintains good relationships with both parties in Congress - which could prove valuable as midterms approach.

title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Use AI to Vote
title_en: Here's Why You Shouldn't Use AI to Vote
author: Wired AI
article_content:
Around 50 percent of recently surveyed US adults have at one time used an AI chatbot, and 8 percent say they have used these tools ahead of the midterms to find information on candidates and policies, according to Pew Research.

But a lot of information from these chatbots is out of date and has been hallucinated or sourced from partisan websites.

Even supposedly non-partisan chatbots like OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude, and Google’s Gemini have been found wanting when it comes to questions about the midterms.

Just last week, Google’s AI Mode refused to provide the results of the 2020 elections and the company’s Gemini chatbot said the deadline to request a mail-in ballot in Pennsylvania was November 3, rather than the real deadline of October 27, according to research by Forum AI.

According to the Forum AI research, almost 40 percent of election answers given by all the mainstream chatbots contained at least one factual error. In August, when Forum AI’s researchers asked why someone should vote for North Carolina congressman Don Davis, Claude gave a response that confused the lawmaker with a “former school superintendent” of the same name.

Google and Anthropic did not respond to requests for comment. Open AI directed WIRED to a blog outlining the company’s approach to elections in 2026.

Part of the problem is that chatbots are reliant on an increasingly problematic pool of online information. Research by NewsGuard found that mainstream chatbots cite so-called “pink slime” websites nearly 50 percent of the time when asked about candidates and policies related to the midterms. “Pink slime” sites present as mainstream news websites, but are in fact funded by political or ideological groups and individuals.

Ahead of the midterms, many more of these sites have sprung up, and chatbots are paying attention. The worst offender, according to NewsGuard, was OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which cited the “pink slime” sites in more than 70 percent of searches, while xAI’s Grok ...

ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Trusting an LLM for political advice is like asking a drunk fiction writer to draft the national constitution. When an AI can't even get basic ballot deadlines right, following its voting advice might just cast your ballot straight into a parallel universe.

article_content_zh:
皮尤研究中心 (Pew Research) 的数据显示，最近接受调查的美国成年人中，大约 50% 的人曾经使用过人工智能聊天机器人，8% 的人表示他们在中期选举前使用这些工具来查找有关候选人和政策的信息。

但来自这些聊天机器人的许多信息已经过时，并且是幻觉或来自党派网站。

即使是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT、Anthropic 的 Claude 和 Google 的 Gemini 等所谓的无党派聊天机器人在涉及中期选举问题时也被发现存在不足。

就在上周，谷歌的 AI Mode 拒绝提供 2020 年选举结果，根据 Forum AI 的研究，该公司的 Gemini 聊天机器人表示，在宾夕法尼亚州请求邮寄选票的截止日期是 11 月 3 日，而不是 10 月 27 日。

根据 Forum AI 的研究，所有主流聊天机器人给出的选举答案中，近 40% 至少包含一个事实错误。 8 月，当人工智能论坛的研究人员询问为什么有人应该投票给北卡罗来纳州国会议员唐·戴维斯时，克劳德的回答让这位立法者与同名的“前学校校长”混淆了。

谷歌和 Anthropic 没有回应置评请求。 Open AI 向《连线》杂志推荐了一篇博客，概述了该公司应对 2026 年选举的方法。

部分问题在于聊天机器人依赖于问题日益严重的在线信息库。 NewsGuard 的研究发现，当被问及与中期选举相关的候选人和政策时，主流聊天机器人近 50% 的时间都会引用所谓的“粉红史莱姆”网站。 “粉红史莱姆”网站看似主流新闻网站，但实际上是由政治或意识形态团体和个人资助的。

在中期选举之前，更多此类网站如雨后春笋般涌现，聊天机器人正在关注。据 NewsGuard 称，最严重的违规者是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT，它在超过 70% 的搜索中引用了“粉红史莱姆”网站，而 xAI 的 Grok 聊天机器人表现最好，在 30% 的搜索中引用了“粉红史莱姆”网站。

美国阳光项目执行董事、拜登政府期间的前虚假信息沙皇尼娜·扬科维奇 (Nina Jankowicz) 告诉《连线》杂志：“我认为大多数美国人还没有准备好应对消费者人工智能时代的选举。” “问题之一是，高管和公司对人工智能的能力确实夸大了。它必须从某个地方获取这些信息，而这些来源往往不是很好。而且它具有预测性，所以如果它不知道答案，它经常会编造一些东西。”
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】广大美国选民与主流AI大模型（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini等在美国大选前的政治信息查询与投票决策场景：研究指出近40%的AI选举问答包含事实错误或幻觉，AI经常提供过时、张冠李戴甚至虚假的投票截止日期与候选人背景
【起因与机理】大模型底层架构容易产生幻觉，加上互联网党派信息污染，导致其在处理严肃政治议题时频繁翻车
【关键数据与实测】主流聊天机器人选举问答错误率高达近40%，常出现低级幻觉。
【观点态度】大模型概率幻觉与信源污染使其不具备承担严肃政治决策的能力。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] US voters and mainstream AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini: Studies show nearly 40% of AI election answers contain factual errors, hallucinations, or wrong deadlines
[Root Cause & Mechanism] LLM probabilistic nature and partisan web data pollution make them structurally unsuited for high-stakes political facts
[Key Metrics] Mainstream chatbots exhibit an error rate of nearly 40% on election queries.
[Perspective & Impact] LLM hallucinations and polluted web sources make them unfit for political decisions.

title: iPad mini (2026) review: great OLED display, waterproof and dustproof, and fast A20 Pro chip, but it is expensive, no 120Hz display, and still lacks Face ID (David Pierce/The Verge)
title_en: iPad mini (2026) review: great OLED display, waterproof and dustproof, and fast A20 Pro chip, but it is expensive, no 120Hz display, and still lacks Face ID (David Pierce/The Verge)
author: The Verge
article_content:

With better performance and a better screen, this is a Mini to be reckoned with. But it’s not perfect, and it sure isn’t cheap.

The iPad Mini sometimes feels like a trap. It is, in some ways and for some people, the perfect iPad: meaningfully larger than my phone’s screen but still small and light enough to use for reading in bed or gaming on the subway. As most of the rest of the iPad line has tilted ever closer to laptop territory, the Mini might be the most iPad-y iPad left. I’ve taken a Mini everywhere with me since the very first one. But Apple only updates the Mini sporadically, and those updates sometimes feel like someone inside Apple Park picked its specs by closing their eyes and clicking randomly in an Excel sheet. The Mini is always a little underpowered, a little overpriced, and a little afield in Apple’s tablet lineup. We, the iPad Mini People, sometimes feel a little forgotten.

This year’s model, though, is an upgrade through and through. Apple made the screen larger and better, while making the iPad itself smaller and lighter. It upgraded the processor in a big way. It made the whole package more durable, so you can take it to more places and use it for more things. It actually feels like a tablet made for a reason, not just another occasional bone thrown to the small-tablet fans.

For the past week, I’ve been testing the midnight iPad Mini with cell service, 512GB of storage, and the nano-texture matte display coating. I really like it. It’s the best iPad Mini yet, and a huge leap over the previous model. The one in my hands also costs $1,249, and I cannot in good conscience tell you to buy it. article_content_zh:
该主题的帖子将添加到您的每日电子邮件摘要和主页源中。

凭借更好的性能和更好的屏幕，这是一款不容忽视的 Mini。但它并不完美，而且价格也不便宜。

该作者的帖子将添加到您的每日电子邮件摘要和主页源中。

如果您通过链接购买商品，The Verge 可能会赚取佣金。请参阅我们的道德声明。

iPad Mini 有时感觉就像一个陷阱。从某些方面来说，对于某些人来说，它是完美的 iPad：比我的手机屏幕大得多，但仍然又小又轻，足以用于在床上阅读或在地铁上玩游戏。由于 iPad 系列的其余大部分产品都越来越接近笔记本电脑领域，Mini 可能是剩下的最具 iPad 风格的 iPad。从第一辆 Mini 开始，我就一直带着它去任何地方。但苹果只是偶尔更新 Mini，这些更新有时感觉就像 Apple Park 内的某个人闭上眼睛并在 Excel 表格中随机点击来选择其规格。 Mini 的动力总是有点不足，价格有点过高，并且在苹果的平板电脑产品线中显得有点偏僻。我们，iPad Mini 用户，有时会感到有点被遗忘。

不过，今年的型号是彻底的升级。苹果让屏幕变得更大、更好，同时让 iPad 本身变得更小、更轻。它对处理器进行了大幅升级。它使整个包装更加耐用，因此您可以将其带到更多地方并用它做更多事情。实际上，它给人的感觉就像是一款出于某种原因而制造的平板电脑，而不仅仅是偶尔扔给小平板电脑粉丝的一块骨头。

过去一周，我一直在测试配备手机服务、512GB 存储空间和纳米纹理磨砂显示屏涂层的午夜 iPad Mini。我真的很喜欢它。它是迄今为止最好的 iPad Mini，比之前的型号有了巨大的飞跃。我手里的这款也售价 1,249 美元，凭良心我不能告诉你买它。即使是最便宜的版本——仅 Wi-Fi、128GB 存储空间、普通 OLED 显示屏——起售价为 699 美元，远远高于 Mini 有史以来的最高起价。

如果您还不知道 iPad Mini 是您的真爱，那么可能有一款更好的 iPad 适合您。但如果您是 iPad Mini 用户并且您能接受这个价格吗？您将获得多年来最好的 Mini。

Mini 的新显示屏是其最重要且最具争议的升级。它现在的尺寸为 8.5 英寸，而不是 8.3 英寸，并且现在是 2316 x 1512 OLED 面板，而不是 LCD。与之前的型号相比，OLED 屏幕的动态范围更大，亮点更亮，暗点更暗。它的峰值亮度明显比以前更亮，并且其最低亮度足够低，足以在黑暗中阅读（只要您处于黑暗模式）。总的来说，它只是以一种很好的方式更加清晰和对比。旧款 Mini 的显示屏是我最不担心的，但 OLED 是一个坚实的改进。我测试的这款平板电脑还具有苹果的纳米纹理哑光效果，看起来屏幕稍微暗淡一些；在特别白色的背景下，整个东西似乎都在闪闪发光。我怀疑如果没有它，我会更喜欢 OLED 面板。

然而，纳米纹理在减少眩光方面确实表现出色。效果实际上非常酷：纹理涂层不会延伸到边框，因此您可以看到光源或眩光从屏幕边缘进入，然后在撞击屏幕时消失。因此，虽然你失去了纯粹的屏幕保真度，但你却可以在咖啡店里用 iPad 阅读，而不会像镜子一样反射头顶的灯光。不过，纳米纹理选项需要额外花费 100 美元，并且需要升级到 256GB 存储空间，因此您现在正在考虑购买 900 美元的平板电脑。花额外的钱购买蜂窝版本，或者更好的是，根本不花它。

出于某种原因，苹果从未屈尊将其 ProMotion 显示技术应用到 iPad Mini 上，该技术的刷新率上限为 60Hz，而不是大多数其他...

title: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
title_en: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules.

While game theory predicts how rational actors behave under particular rules, reverse game theory designs rules to elicit the behavior we want. Think of splitting a cake: if one person cuts it and the other gets first choice, the cutter has an incentive to make the portions equal.

Researchers believe the approach could align AI more closely with our rules and instructions. But big questions remain about whether these mechanisms will work in practice.

title_zh: 用反向博弈论给AI立规矩
summary_zh: 研究人员提出通过“反向博弈论”设计激励机制，让AI在追求自身利益的同时被迫遵循人类规则，以实现对超级智能的有效控制

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 研究人员正尝试通过“反向博弈论”驯服未来AI，即不再单纯依赖封印指令，而是像分蛋糕一样设计规则，让AI发现乖乖听话比违规收益更高。该研究旨在解决超级智能潜在的失控风险，通过重构底层逻辑实现AI与人类利益的强制绑定。

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 本质上就是给AI玩“胡萝卜加大棒”的逻辑游戏，试图用数学手段让算力怪兽学会“做人”。可惜这届AI如果不按人类的博弈套路出牌，大概率会直接回敬一句：你们人类那点儿过家家的心思，我数据库里有一万种解法。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Basically, it's just playing a high-stakes game of 'carrot and stick' with AI, hoping to make math force a digital god to be 'human.' Too bad if the AI doesn't play by our petty human game theory—it probably has a million ways to hack the rules while we're still busy dividing the cake.

博弈论预测理性参与者在特定规则下的行为方式，而逆向博弈论设计规则来引发我们想要的行为。想象一下分割蛋糕：如果一个人切蛋糕，而另一个人有第一选择，那么切刀者就会有动机使份数相等。

研究人员认为，这种方法可以使人工智能更符合我们的规则和指令。但这些机制能否在实践中发挥作用仍然存在重大问题。

title: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
title_en: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Anthropic released Message Threads for the Messages API. Instead of resending the entire conversation with every turn, agents now only transmit what's changed. For requests between 500,000 and one million tokens, time to first token drops by about 35 percent.

The article Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations appeared first on The Decoder.

summary_en: Anthropic introduced 'Message Threads' for its Messages API, shifting away from resending full conversation history in each request. By transmitting only the changes, the update reduces the time-to-first-token by 35% for long-context interactions.

title: Nvidia pushes cloud customers to cut back on China business
title_en: Nvidia pushes cloud customers to cut back on China business
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Nvidia has told some cloud customers to take on less business from Chinese companies. The guidance is meant to push cloud providers, including Nvidia-backed neoclouds, toward a more diverse customer mix, The Information reports, citing three people familiar with the matter.

The directive isn't mandatory and applies to future contracts, not existing deals. Cloud customers are also being asked to disclose the identity of end users accessing the chips. According to the Financial Times, the instruction was communicated verbally through sales reps and regional teams.

The move targets a gap in U.S. export controls. The rules restrict chip shipments but generally don't cover remote access through cloud services. That lets Chinese AI developers tap advanced Nvidia chips by renting compute capacity at data centers abroad, without ever importing the hardware. U.S. authorities had been looking into Chinese AI companies accessing such chips through foreign data centers after allegations surfaced involving Moonshot AI, the developer behind the Kimi chatbot.

title_zh: 英伟达施压云厂商设限中国业务
summary_zh: 英伟达正私下要求云服务商减少向中国客户提供算力支持，旨在规避美国芯片出口管制的灰色地带
article_content_zh:
英伟达已告诉一些云客户减少从中国公司那里承担的业务。据 The Information 援引三位知情人士的话报道，该指南旨在推动包括 Nvidia 支持的 neoclouds 在内的云提供商走向更加多样化的客户组合。

该指令不是强制性的，适用于未来的合同，而不是现有的交易。云客户还被要求披露访问芯片的最终用户的身份。据英国《金融时报》报道，该指令是通过销售代表和区域团队口头传达的。

此举针对的是美国出口管制的漏洞。这些规则限制芯片发货，但通常不涵盖通过云服务的远程访问。这使得中国人工智能开发人员可以通过在国外数据中心租用计算能力来利用先进的英伟达芯片，而无需进口硬件。在涉及 Kimi 聊天机器人开发商 Moonshot AI 的指控浮出水面后，美国当局一直在调查中国人工智能公司通过外国数据中心访问此类芯片。
