title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
title_en: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter.

The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder.
content_snippet:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter.

The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: OpenAI has restructured its Model Spec around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. The update forces GPT models to infer user needs from conversation history and disclose their logic.
title_zh: OpenAI重修AI行为准则
summary_zh: OpenAI更新模型规范，围绕人类意图和可修正性等五大核心价值观重构AI行为指导原则

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI更新了其模型规范（Model Spec），将AI行为准则重新架构为包括“忠实于人类意图”和“可修正性”在内的五大核心价值观。此举旨在要求模型利用对话历史推断用户真实意图并披露模型假设，以解决目前模型难以被完全管控的问题。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI has restructured its Model Spec around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. The update forces GPT models to infer user needs from conversation history and disclose their logic.

elements_zh.where: 模型规范（Model Spec）文档
elements_zh.what: 发布新的行为准则，要求AI理解人类意图并主动披露假设
elements_zh.why: 应对大模型行为难以预测和管控的长期顽疾

elements_en.what: Introduced new guidelines focusing on human intent and transparency
elements_en.why: To tackle the persistent issue of uncontrollable and unpredictable AI behavior

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 给AI立规矩就像给顽皮的猫讲道理，哪怕你写得再严谨，它该抓沙发的时候照抓不误。OpenAI与其说是给AI升级，不如说是给用户打好预防针：模型犯错时，它那是‘有理有据’地犯错。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Setting rules for an LLM is like lecturing a cat—it'll keep shredding the couch regardless of how eloquent your treatise is. OpenAI isn't just updating protocols; they're just pre-framing the excuse for when the model inevitably hallucinates.

article_content_zh:
OpenAI 更新了其模型规范，围绕五个核心价值观重组了人工智能行为指南，包括忠实于人类意图和可纠正性。 GPT 模型现在应该利用对话历史来找出用户真正想要什么并披露他们自己的假设。模型是否遵循这些规则是另一回事。

title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
title_en: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Reddit首席执行官近期公开抨击谷歌的AI概览（AI Overviews）和AI模式，称其导致网站每周损失超过百万的搜索推荐流量。为应对这种“零点击”流量劫持，Reddit正测试登录墙等防御措施，试图将流量闭环为直接访问，而非依赖外部搜索引擎。

title: Sam Altman sympathizes with mathematicians, but says OpenAI’s math onslaught won’t stop

author: The Verge AI

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在播客访谈中，OpenAI首席执行官山姆·奥特曼针对数月来AI密集生成推演结果对数学界造成的验证冲击首次正面回应。他坦言十分同情疲于应付海量AI成果的数学家，但明确表态绝不会放缓脚步，并透露公司已储备了更多研究发现即将抛出。奥特曼强调人类理应看清宇宙运转规律，暗示学术界的消化不良不会动摇OpenAI持续释放技术推演的既定策略。

title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
title_en: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Epoch AI researchers say the widely available AI model GLM 5.3 turned public security fixes into working exploits before updates reached Firefox users. It autonomously compromised six Firefox releases for about $1,000 in API fees each without triggering safeguards from any provider tested.

content_snippet:

title: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)
title_en: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: China's CXMT (688825.SS) said on Friday it swung to a net profit in the third quarter as surging AI-driven demand drove prices higher for its memory chips.
summary_en: CXMT reported Q3 revenue of $16.7 billion, a 613.2% year-on-year increase, with a net profit of $8.17 billion. Driven by the surge in demand for high-performance memory chips from AI model training and inference, the company successfully transitioned from losses to profitability as market prices rose.

title: NAND maker Kioxia reports FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with est., but forecasts Q3 operating profit of ~$12.7B, below ~$14.9B est. (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
title_en: NAND maker Kioxia reports FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with est., but forecasts Q3 operating profit of ~$12.7B, below ~$14.9B est. (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Kioxia Holdings Corp. delivered a profit outlook that trailed estimates, warning that an AI-fueled surge in flash memory chip prices …
summary_en: NAND flash maker Kioxia reported that its fiscal Q2 operating profit soared 22-fold year-over-year to approximately $12.7 billion, meeting market expectations. However, the company forecasted Q3 operating profit at a similar $12.7 billion, falling well short of Wall Street estimates of roughly $14.9 billion. The conservative outlook reflects lingering sluggishness in consumer electronics and ongoing client inventory management despite strong AI-driven enterprise demand.
title_zh: 铠侠二季度利润暴增22倍但下季指引逊于预期
summary_zh: 铠侠第二财季营业利润同比激增22倍符合预期，但给出的第三财季指引不及分析师预期，引发市场担忧

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 存储芯片巨头铠侠在最新财务会议上公布第二财季营业利润同比激增22倍至约12.7亿美元，与此前市场预期基本吻合。然而，公司给出的第三财季营业利润指引同样仅约12.7亿美元，显著落后于华尔街分析师普遍预期的14.9亿美元。受智能手机与PC消费终端复苏乏力、客户库存调整影响，即便有AI服务器拉动的高端闪存需求，铠侠对未来几个季度的盈利持续反弹仍持谨慎态度。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: NAND flash maker Kioxia reported that its fiscal Q2 operating profit soared 22-fold year-over-year to approximately $12.7 billion, meeting market expectations. The conservative outlook reflects lingering sluggishness in consumer electronics and ongoing client inventory management despite strong AI-driven enterprise demand.

elements_en.who: Flash memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings Corp.

elements_en.why: Cyclical recovery remains uneven, with strong AI enterprise demand overshadowed by sluggish smartphone and PC consumer markets

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 存储周期这把过山车，铠侠算是玩得明明白白：上一秒刚借着AI东风扭亏暴赚22倍，下一秒就立刻给资本市场泼了盆冷水。闪存大厂的算盘从来没变过，涨价时高喊产能吃紧疯狂敛财，给预期时立马哭诉消费电子寒冬，主打一个把周期操控权牢牢攥在自己手里。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Kioxia is playing the classic memory cycle playbook: riding the AI wave to deliver a headline-grabbing 22x profit jump, only to immediately pour cold water on Wall Street with weak guidance. Flash makers love nothing more than crying poverty about consumer demand right after pocketing windfall profits, keeping investors on their toes and market expectations artificially low.

title: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)
title_en: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta (META.O) was imposing exploitative terms …
summary_en: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has launched an antitrust investigation into Meta, examining whether the tech giant abused its market dominance to impose exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers. The regulator suspect Meta forced content creators to forfeit proprietary text and ad materials for training its AI models without fair compensation or viable opt-out options. This move marks an escalating regulatory crackdown on Big Tech scraping ecosystem content under the guise of platform service terms.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英国竞争与市场管理局正式对Meta启动反垄断立案调查，重点审查该公司是否滥用在社交媒体和数字广告领域的市场支配地位，对内容出版商与广告客户施加苛刻的剥削性条款。监管机构怀疑Meta强制将其平台上客户创作的新闻、文章和广告素材无偿或廉价捆绑用于自身AI大模型及算法服务的研发迭代。随着内容版权方与生成式AI阵营的摩擦加剧，监管部门正试图切断大厂利用平台生态优势巧取豪夺训练数据的行为路径。

title: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
title_en: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.

GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinicians, they can represent something sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

A new report suggests the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up by 71% between 1990 and 2023. And clinicians are already seeing GLP-1s exacerbate the issue.

title: Dream, which is training AI world models on US building data to automate construction design and engineering, emerges from stealth with a $17M seed led by a16z (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
title_en: Dream, which is training AI world models on US building data to automate construction design and engineering, emerges from stealth with a $17M seed led by a16z (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur were Stanford roommates who both studied computer science before spending a decade at Palantir. Elder led product design for a team of 800 people building software for U.S. defense and intelligence agencies, while Mathur served as a senior vice president in the company’s commercial practice. When the friends decided to build a startup early last year, there was no question they would do it together.

Despite having no direct background in architecture, Elder and Mathur were troubled by a growing problem: Fewer buildings are constructed in the U.S. today than a few decades ago, as development costs have surged.

“We’ve gone from dial-up internet to superintelligent AI, but our ability to build the physical world around us has actually decreased,” Mathur told TechCrunch.

Believing AI can boost productivity across the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, they set out to build Dream, a startup developing built world models that automate building design and engineering. Dream has emerged from stealth with $17 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, alongside other backers, including SV Angel, XYZ, and Zigg Capital. The startup aims to replace cumbersome, outdated AEC tools like Autodesk’s AutoCAD and Revit.

If you sit next to an architect or a structural engineer, you’ll notice that they are still “drawing” every piece of their designs part by part on legacy software, Mathur said. “AI really plays no role in that equation.”

While a standard LLM like ChatGPT can generate an image of a building, the result won’t be structurally sound. Dream, by contrast, is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream’s world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

“Our model actually understands what’s within those walls. What materials are used, what the beams are made of, and how much weight ...

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 搞国防大数据的Palantir老兵跨界来工地指点江山，指出的痛点倒极为讽刺：硅谷把人类送进了算力过剩的虚拟世界，现实中却连一栋像样的大楼都盖不起。不过比起自动化绘图，这套AI模型最先需要学会的可能不是算承重抗震，而是怎么帮开发商用AI写出厚厚一叠能够糊弄过美国市政审批委员会的合规套话。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Palantir veterans pivoting from defense data to the construction site hits on a hilarious irony: tech has brought us to superintelligent AI while making it too expensive to lay actual bricks. That said, before automating blueprint drafts, Dream's models better learn how to churn out the exact bureaucratic jargon required to pass local US zoning boards.

article_content_zh:
安迪·埃尔德 (Andy Elder) 和阿琼·马图尔 (Arjun Mathur) 是斯坦福大学的室友，他们在 Palantir 工作了十年之前都学习了计算机科学。埃尔德负责为美国国防和情报机构构建软件的 800 人团队的产品设计，而马图尔则担任公司商业业务的高级副总裁。当朋友们去年初决定创办一家初创公司时，毫无疑问他们会一起做。

尽管没有直接的建筑背景，埃尔德和马图尔却被一个日益严重的问题所困扰：随着开发成本的飙升，如今美国建造的建筑物比几十年前减少了。

“我们已经从拨号互联网发展到超级智能人工智能，但我们构建周围物理世界的能力实际上有所下降，”马图尔告诉 TechCrunch。

他们相信人工智能可以提高整个建筑、工程和施工 (AEC) 行业的生产力，因此着手建立 Dream，这是一家开发建筑世界模型的初创公司，可实现建筑设计和工程自动化。 Dream 已从隐秘状态中脱颖而出，获得了由 Andreessen Horowitz 领投的 1700 万美元种子资金，其他支持者包括 SV Angel、XYZ 和 Zigg Capital。该初创公司的目标是取代繁琐、过时的 AEC 工具，例如 Autodesk 的 AutoCAD 和 Revit。

马图尔说，如果你坐在建筑师或结构工程师旁边，你会注意到他们仍然在遗留软件上逐个部分地“绘制”他们的每一个设计。 “人工智能在这个等式中确实没有发挥任何作用。”

虽然像 ChatGPT 这样的标准法学硕士可以生成建筑物的图像，但结果在结构上并不健全。相比之下，梦想是基于真实的物理和建筑标准。正如法学硕士从文本中学习一样，Dream 的世界模型是根据从美国各地许可证档案中收集的超过 1 亿平方英尺的建筑数据进行训练的。

“我们的模型实际上了解这些墙内有什么。使用什么材料，梁是由什么制成的，以及它们可以支撑多少重量，”埃尔德说。

该初创公司将其方法称为“结构认知”，因为其模型生成结构精确的设计，考虑了管道和暖通空调等内部建筑元素。

据创始人称，Dream 已经开始向 AEC 专业人士和开发商销售其产品，他们使用该模型来概念化建筑设计并估算总体成本。该平台已部署在德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州的 10 个活跃项目中。

虽然 Dream 并不是唯一一家尝试用 AI 更新 AEC 软件的公司（其他致力于此的初创公司包括 Motif、Snaptrude 和 Arcol），但 Elder 和 Mathur 声称他们是唯一开发出可立即设计整个建筑的世界模型的公司。

Andreessen Horowitz 合伙人 Kimberly Tan 表示，虽然该公司一年多前首次投资 Dream，当时创业模式还只是一个想法，但他们的进展给她留下了极其深刻的印象。 “我还没有看到有人采取技术方法，”她说。 “他们所做的一切都是基于自己的模式。”

Marina Temkin 是 TechCrunch 的风险投资和初创企业记者。在加入 TechCrunch 之前，她为 PitchBook 和 Venture Capital Journal 撰写了有关风险投资的文章。在她职业生涯的早期，玛丽娜是一名金融分析师，并获得了特许金融分析师 (CFA) 资格。

title: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
title_en: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
author: Tech.eu
content_snippet: As AI transforms the accounting industry, Ravical aims to help firms turn individual expertise into shared knowledge …
summary_en: Ravical, an AI-powered operational platform tailored for accounting and tax practices, has closed a $17 million seed round led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25 million. The platform applies AI automation to streamline administrative operations, compliance reviews, and workflow orchestration for professional service firms. The funding comes amid increasing regulatory complexities and chronic talent shortages across the tax and accounting sectors.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 面向会计与税务专业机构的AI运营管理平台Ravical宣布完成由风险投资机构MMC领投的1700万美元新一轮种子融资，至此该公司的累计融资额已攀升至2500万美元。该平台专门整合财税业务流程，运用AI技术自动化处理复杂的会计操作流、合规排查与任务调度。随着全球税务政策频密调整以及财税专业人才严重断层，传统事务所长期被人工填表和琐碎核算拖累，该技术方案旨在帮其从机械性事务中脱身以保住业务利润率。

The funding comes amid increasing regulatory complexities and chronic talent shortages across the tax and accounting sectors.

title: Inside Nscale's 2,250-acre, 8GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, which has been hit by construction issues, local opposition, and financing risks (Financial Times)
title_en: Inside Nscale's 2,250-acre, 8GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, which has been hit by construction issues, local opposition, and financing risks (Financial Times)
author: Financial Times
content_snippet: Nvidia-backed neocloud bets on West Virginia data centre campus hit by construction issues, local opposition and financing risks — NEW
summary_en: Nscale, an Nvidia-backed neocloud startup, has encountered major setbacks at its massive 2,250-acre, 8-gigawatt Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia. Designed to capitalize on explosive generative AI workloads, the project is now plagued by construction issues, fierce local community opposition, and looming financing risks. The ambitious venture highlights the severe friction between aggressive AI infrastructure buildouts and local electrical and economic realities.
title_zh: 英伟达参投算力新贵受挫 西弗吉尼亚超级园区遇阻
summary_zh: 算力服务商Nscale在西弗吉尼亚规划的8吉瓦超级数据中心遭遇施工延误、社区抗议与融资风险等多重阻击
article_content_zh:
随着前沿大语言模型参数规模呈指数级飙升，全球对AI专用数据中心的电力与物理空间需求达到了前所未有的狂热阶段。获英伟达深度技术支持的欧洲算力云服务商Nscale原本计划在西弗吉尼亚州打造全美乃至全球单体规模最大的计算枢纽之一——占地超过2250英亩、总规划功率达8吉瓦的“君主计算园区”（Monarch Compute Campus）。

然而，这一宏大蓝图在落地实施阶段却全面亮起红灯。现场工程不仅因复杂地形与基础设施配套缺陷遭遇严重的施工延期，当地居民和环保组织也因担心该设施对本地电网造成不可承受的负荷挤兑、推高民用电价以及带来持续性工业噪音，爆发了密集的公开抗议活动。雪上加霜的是，由于工期反复拖延和宏观利率居高不下，原本对该超级项目跃跃欲试的财团与信贷机构正收紧借贷条件，令项目面临严重的再融资风险。

业内人士指出，Nscale的挫折具有鲜明的行业代表性。伴随英伟达生态下众多“新云”（Neocloud）企业的野蛮生长，算力资本正以前所未有的速度试图在廉价能源聚集地圈地起楼，但电力传输扩容周期的漫长、本土政策审批的严苛以及重资产投资回报的不确定性，正成为阻遏这股AI基建热潮的最现实瓶颈。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 获英伟达支持的新兴算力云企业Nscale，在美国西弗吉尼亚州规划占地2250英亩、规模高达8吉瓦的“君主计算园区”项目陷入重重危机。该项目旨在承接爆发式的生成式AI算力需求，但在实际落地中接连遭遇现场施工故障、当地社区居民抗议以及巨额资金链吃紧等多重现实阻碍。超大规模AI基建的狂热扩张，正在电网承载力与地方现实博弈中直面严峻考验。

title: Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.
title_en: Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinical psychologists, they can represent something more sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

A new report suggests that the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up between 1990 and 2023—by a whopping 71%. By 2023, there were an estimated 18.1 million people living with one of these two disorders.

What’s worse is that the number is likely to be much higher than that once we factor in other eating disorders. And, disturbingly, those in the field are already starting to see GLP-1 weight-loss drugs exacerbating the issue.

content_snippet: Streaming service plans to charge users up to $5 a month to use the feature — Spotify is targeting an early 2027 launch …
summary_en: Global streaming giant Spotify is planning to roll out a generative AI product in the first quarter of 2027 that enables subscribers to produce remixes and covers for an additional fee of around $5 per month. The commercial launch hinges on successful music licensing agreements with major record labels. This initiative aims to unlock new subscription revenue streams while attempting to institutionalize and monetize user-generated remixes under compliant royalty structures.
title_zh: 声田拟推出AI音乐重混工具 用户每月或需额外支付五美元
summary_zh: 全球流媒体巨头声田正筹划在三年后推出AI音乐重混与翻唱功能，计划向订阅用户每月加收约五美元增值费

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 全球流媒体巨头声田计划于2027年第一季度推出一项全新的生成式AI产品，允许订阅用户直接生成歌曲的重混与翻唱版本，每月预计增收约5美元订阅费。该功能的最终落地将完全取决于平台能否与各大唱片公司敲定版权授权协议。声田此举旨在挖掘音乐流媒体的存量增值空间，并试图通过官方分润机制将草根二创收编为合规变现渠道。

This initiative aims to unlock new subscription revenue streams while attempting to institutionalize and monetize user-generated remixes under compliant royalty structures.

title: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
title_en: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion raid on cryptocurrency exchange Binance, according to US blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs.
summary_en: Security firm TRM Labs confirmed that the North Korea-linked hacker group TraderTraitor drained $6.36 billion from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains in just 20 minutes. Facing the largest crypto heist in history, Binance has publicly pledged to fully cover all user losses.

Facing the largest crypto heist in history, Binance has publicly pledged to fully cover all user losses.

title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
title_en: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
author: NBC News
content_snippet: The DeepSeek AI mobile app.Andrey Rudakov / Bloomberg via Getty Add NBC News to GoogleOct. 29, 2026, 6:00 PM EDTBy Kevin CollierChinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.
summary_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.
title_zh: 黑客利用深度求索等大模型工具 11天内猛攻两百家机构
summary_zh: 黑客组织利用集成了深度求索等大模型的AI工具，在11天内对全球超200家机构发动网络攻击并攻破至少9家
article_content_zh:
网络空间攻防对抗显示，黑客正在将开源大语言模型嵌入自研的自动化武器库中。在一款代号为ARTEX的攻击套件里，攻击者将深度求索（DeepSeek）大模型作为自动化侦察与脆弱性匹配的决策引擎，辅以其他模型进行代码微调，从而在极短时间内对海量网络节点完成指纹识别与漏洞探测。

这场历时仅11天的闪电式攻击波及了全球逾200家机构，并确认有至少9家关键实体的防御壁垒被撕破。相较于传统由高级渗透工程师逐一手工扫描、编写利用载荷的做法，大模型的介入将整个渗透前期的情报搜集与试错周期压缩了数个数量级。

该事件反映出生成式AI攻防失衡的现实困境：开源大模型的普及虽然让算力与模型获取成本剧烈下探，但也直接使具备初中级网络对抗能力的黑客组织获得了此前只有顶级国家级团队才拥有的高并发工业化渗透能力。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 黑客组织在近期攻击行动中利用名为ARTEX的自动化工具，集成了开源大模型深度求索（DeepSeek）及另一款模型，在短短11天内席卷全球200多家机构，并成功渗透攻破了至少9家目标。此次行动旨在通过大模型的自然语言处理与自动化代码生成能力，成百倍压缩侦察与漏洞利用的准备周期，展现了生成式AI将传统需要大批人力的网络渗透流水线化运作的破坏力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.

elements_zh.who: 疑似具备特定国家背景的黑客组织与受害网络机构
elements_zh.where: 全球范围内的目标机构网络与云端服务器基础设施
elements_zh.what: 利用集成深度求索大模型的AI渗透工具，11天内高频攻击200余家机构并攻陷至少9家

elements_en.who: State-linked threat actors and targeted global organizations
elements_en.where: Global network infrastructures and organizational servers
elements_en.what: Weaponized an AI intrusion tool integrated with DeepSeek to assault 200+ targets in 11 days, breaching at least nine
elements_en.why: Leveraged low-cost, high-speed open-source AI reasoning to scale and industrialize reconnaissance and exploitation

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 硅谷大厂还在为大模型到底能不能代替实习生做PPT争得面红耳赤，黑客老哥们早已用开源模型跑出了惊人的投资回报率。深度求索主打一个极致性价比，没曾想先成了黑客流水线上的最佳“降本增效”利器——开源AI还没打倒闭源巨头，先让全球网络安防运维集体通宵加班了。
ai_analysis.insight_en: While Big Tech still squabbles over whether LLMs can reliably build slide decks, threat actors have already operationalized open-source models with brutal ROI. DeepSeek sold the world on extreme efficiency, only for adversaries to turn it into the ultimate automated exploit pipeline—keeping global IT defense teams awake all night.

title: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from "potential disruption" amid geopolitical tensions with China (Joseph C. Sternberg/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from "potential disruption" amid geopolitical tensions with China (Joseph C. Sternberg/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America's top foreign policy interests.
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a critical dependency on TSMC for AI chip manufacturing. The company warns that any potential supply chain disruption stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Taiwan Strait would pose a severe threat to its operational continuity.
title_zh: Anthropic披露严重依赖台积电
summary_zh: Anthropic在S-1文件中警告，其核心算力高度依赖台积电，台海地缘政治动荡构成重大运营风险
article_content_zh:
Anthropic在最新的上市申请材料中，将台积电明确列为关键风险因素。作为AI领域头部企业，其核心业务完全架构在尖端芯片之上，而目前全球具备该先进制程产能的厂商仅限台积电一家。

分析指出，这一表态不仅是出于上市合规的常规风险揭露，更揭示了当前科技巨头在算力军备竞赛中面临的集体焦虑：即便是估值数百亿的顶级AI厂商，在物理层面上仍极其脆弱，极度缺乏供应链的多样性冗余。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 人工智能初创公司Anthropic在上市招股书（S-1）中明确指出，其模型训练与推理严重依赖台积电的芯片代工。该公司强调，鉴于台海局势的复杂性，一旦供应链发生中断，其业务连续性和算力供应将面临毁灭性打击。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a critical dependency on TSMC for AI chip manufacturing. The company warns that any potential supply chain disruption stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Taiwan Strait would pose a severe threat to its operational continuity.

elements_zh.what: 披露对台积电芯片代工的高度依赖，并发出地缘政治风险预警
elements_zh.why: 满足监管合规要求，向投资者提示供应链稳定性风险

elements_en.what: Acknowledged heavy reliance on TSMC and warned of geopolitical supply chain risks

ai_analysis.insight_en: So much for the 'moat' of LLMs—it turns out the real barrier is just a geopolitical game of chicken. These AI unicorns aren't just selling intelligence; they're selling hopes that the world's most sensitive supply chain doesn't catch fire.

title: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
title_en: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. joined forces with one of the market operators behind offshore crypto-trading platform Hyperliquid …
summary_en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the NYSE, has taken an equity stake in Trade.xyz, a prominent market operator on decentralized platform Hyperliquid. The two partners plan to launch US-regulated perpetual futures markets built on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. This initiative reflects traditional finance's drive to capture booming crypto derivatives volume by integrating DeFi liquidity into Wall Street's regulatory framework.

elements_en.why: Traditional finance seeks to tap into high-margin DeFi perpetual volumes and bring unregulated crypto trading under Wall Street control

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 华尔街当年抨击链上赌徒时义正辞严，如今抄起作业来比谁都熟练。看着永续合约这台印钞机每天疯狂进账，老钱们终于坐不住了，连夜给去中心化杠杆工具套上合规外壳端上自家餐桌，嘴上全是风险控制，心里全是指标和佣金。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Wall Street once denounced crypto leverage with moral outrage, but now it is eagerly copying the exact same playbook. Watching decentralized perpetuals rake in billions in fee revenue, the old guard couldn't resist slapping a regulatory stamp on on-chain gambling to ensure they finally get their cut.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 纽交所母公司洲际交易所宣布入股去中心化交易平台Hyperliquid的市场运营商Trade.xyz。双方计划联手在美国推出受监管机构批准的链上永续合约市场。此举旨在将加密原生的高流动性衍生品机制引入传统金融体系，通过合规化包装抢夺下一阶段加密衍生品的交易定价权。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the NYSE, has taken an equity stake in Trade.xyz, a prominent market operator on decentralized platform Hyperliquid. The two partners plan to launch US-regulated perpetual futures markets built on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. This initiative reflects traditional finance's drive to capture booming crypto derivatives volume by integrating DeFi liquidity into Wall Street's regulatory framework.
